1	"""Resilient DOM sanitization, gate unlocking, and structured page extraction helpers.
2	
3	Handles adversarial portal elements (zero-width characters, timed modal <dialog> overlays, decoy triplet
4	links, range+checkbox gates, canvas aria-label receipts/values, CSS-hidden [role=tooltip] elements, and
5	transient /notice error pages) without hardcoding any scenario-specific values.
6	"""
7	from __future__ import annotations
8	
9	import asyncio
10	import re
11	from datetime import datetime, timezone
12	from decimal import Decimal
13	from typing import Any
14	from urllib.parse import urljoin
15	
16	from calculator import (
17	    BonusBand,
18	    DeliveryCommitmentRule,
19	    ErpMaterial,
20	    MailRules,
21	    PriceCondition,
22	    QAClarification,
23	    RequirementSpec,
24	    TenderPosition,
25	    ZERO,
26	    parse_locale_decimal,
27	    parse_timestamp,
28	)
29	
30	ZWC_RE = re.compile(r"[\u200b\u200c\u200d\ufeff\u00ad]")
31	DECOY_HREF_PATTERNS = ("/portal-survey", "/tools", "/documents/supplier-guide", "/logout")
32	
33	
34	def strip_zwc(text: str | None) -> str:
35	    if not text:
36	        return ""
37	    return ZWC_RE.sub("", str(text))
38	
39	
40	PREPARE_PAGE_JS = """
41	() => {
42	    // 1. Close any modal <dialog> popups
43	    document.querySelectorAll('dialog').forEach(d => {
44	        try {
45	            const closeBtn = d.querySelector('button[data-close]');
46	            if (closeBtn) closeBtn.click();
47	            if (d.open) d.close();
48	            d.remove();
49	        } catch (e) {}
50	    });
51	
52	    // 2. Unlock any range + checkbox access gates (Zugangsprüfung)
53	    document.querySelectorAll('section[aria-label="Zugangsprüfung"], [id$="-gate"]').forEach(sec => {
54	        try {
55	            const slider = sec.querySelector('input[type="range"]');
56	            if (slider) {
57	                slider.value = slider.max || '100';
58	                slider.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
59	                slider.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
60	            }
61	            sec.querySelectorAll('input[type="checkbox"]').forEach(cb => {
62	                if (cb.name !== 'acknowledged' && !cb.checked) {
63	                    cb.checked = true;
64	                    cb.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
65	                    cb.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
66	                }
67	            });
68	        } catch (e) {}
69	    });
70	
71	    // 3. Open all <details> elements
72	    document.querySelectorAll('details').forEach(d => {
73	        d.open = true;
74	    });
75	
76	    // 4. Reveal all [role="tooltip"] elements so innerText includes them
77	    document.querySelectorAll('[role="tooltip"]').forEach(t => {
78	        t.style.setProperty('display', 'inline', 'important');
79	        t.style.setProperty('position', 'static', 'important');
80	        t.style.setProperty('visibility', 'visible', 'important');
81	        t.style.setProperty('opacity', '1', 'important');
82	        if (!t.dataset.prefixed) {
83	            t.dataset.prefixed = '1';
84	            t.insertAdjacentText('beforebegin', ' ');
85	            t.insertAdjacentText('afterend', ' ');
86	        }
87	    });
88	
89	    // 5. Expose canvas[aria-label] as visible text while keeping [aria-hidden="true"] hidden
90	    document.querySelectorAll('canvas[aria-label]').forEach(c => {
91	        if (!c.dataset.unhidden) {
92	            c.dataset.unhidden = '1';
93	            const tag = document.createElement('div');
94	            tag.textContent = '[CANVAS: ' + c.getAttribute('aria-label') + ']';
95	            c.parentNode.insertBefore(tag, c);
96	        }
97	    });
98	
99	    // 6. Expose time[datetime] UTC ISO attributes so innerText contains exact UTC timestamps
100	    document.querySelectorAll('time[datetime]').forEach(t => {
101	        if (!t.dataset.dtExposed) {
102	            t.dataset.dtExposed = '1';
103	            t.insertAdjacentText('beforeend', ' · ' + t.getAttribute('datetime'));
104	        }
105	    });
106	}
107	"""
108	
109	
110	async def prepare_page(page) -> None:
111	    """Close dialogs, unlock slider gates, open details, and expose tooltips & canvas aria-labels."""
112	    try:
113	        await page.evaluate(PREPARE_PAGE_JS)
114	    except Exception:
115	        pass
116	
117	
118	async def get_clean_text(page) -> str:
119	    """Prepare the page and return zero-width-stripped visible innerText."""
120	    await prepare_page(page)
121	    try:
122	        raw = await page.locator("body").inner_text(timeout=5000)
123	    except Exception:
124	        raw = await page.content()
125	    return strip_zwc(raw)
126	
127	
128	async def get_actionable_links(page, base_url: str) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
129	    """Return non-decoy visible links on the current page."""
130	    await prepare_page(page)
131	    raw_links = await page.evaluate(
132	        """() => {
133	        const out = [];
134	        document.querySelectorAll('a[href]').forEach(a => {
135	            if (a.hasAttribute('data-unavailable')) return;
136	            const href = a.getAttribute('href') || '';
137	            const text = (a.innerText || a.getAttribute('aria-label') || '').trim();
138	            out.push({ href, text });
139	        });
140	        return out;
141	    }"""
142	    )
143	    clean_links: list[dict[str, str]] = []
144	    seen = set()
145	    for item in raw_links:
146	        href = strip_zwc(item.get("href", "")).strip()
147	        text = strip_zwc(item.get("text", "")).strip()
148	        if not href or href.startswith("#") or href.startswith("javascript:"):
149	            continue
150	        if any(href.startswith(p) or href == p for p in DECOY_HREF_PATTERNS):
151	            continue
152	        full_url = urljoin(base_url, href)
153	        key = (full_url, text)
154	        if key not in seen:
155	            seen.add(key)
156	            clean_links.append({"url": full_url, "path": href, "text": text})
157	    return clean_links
158	
159	
160	async def handle_gates_and_notices(page, target_url: str) -> str:
161	    """Handle cookie consent, ERP /notice receipt gate, customer-portal document access gate, and 503 retries."""
162	    text = ""
163	    for _ in range(5):
164	        text = await get_clean_text(page)
165	
166	        # 1. Cookie consent wall
167	        if "Cookies" in text:
168	            consent_btn = page.locator(
169	                'button[value="accept"], button:has-text("Cookies akzeptieren"), button:has-text("Auswahl bestätigen")'
170	            )
171	            if await consent_btn.count() > 0:
172	                await consent_btn.first.click()
173	                await page.wait_for_load_state("domcontentloaded")
174	                continue
175	
176	        # 2. Transient error page ("Dienst vorübergehend nicht verfügbar")
177	        if "Dienst vorübergehend nicht verfügbar" in text or "Anfrage konnte nicht verarbeitet werden" in text:
178	            await asyncio.sleep(0.2)
179	            await page.goto(target_url, wait_until="domcontentloaded")
180	            continue
181	
182	        # 3. ERP Systemmitteilung receipt gate on /notice
183	        if "Empfangsnummer" in text or "/notice" in page.url:
184	            erp_receipt = page.locator("canvas#erp-receipt")
185	            if await erp_receipt.count() > 0:
186	                label = strip_zwc(await erp_receipt.first.get_attribute("aria-label") or "")
187	                code = label.split(":", 1)[-1].strip() if ":" in label else label.strip()
188	                receipt_input = page.locator('input[name="receipt"]')
189	                if await receipt_input.count() > 0:
190	                    await receipt_input.first.fill(code)
191	                ack_cb = page.locator('input[name="acknowledged"]')
192	                if await ack_cb.count() > 0:
193	                    await ack_cb.first.check()
194	                submit_btn = page.locator('form[action="/notice"] button[type="submit"], button:has-text("Weiter")')
195	                if await submit_btn.count() > 0:
196	                    await submit_btn.first.click()
197	                    await page.wait_for_load_state("domcontentloaded")
198	                    if page.url.rstrip("/") != target_url.rstrip("/"):
199	                        await page.goto(target_url, wait_until="domcontentloaded")
200	                    continue
201	
202	        # 4. Customer portal Dokumentenüberlassung gate
203	        if "Dokumentenüberlassung" in text or "Empfangszeichen" in text:
204	            access_receipt = page.locator("canvas#access-receipt")
205	            if await access_receipt.count() > 0:
206	                label = strip_zwc(await access_receipt.first.get_attribute("aria-label") or "")
207	                code = label.split(":", 1)[-1].strip() if ":" in label else label.strip()
208	                ref_radio = page.locator('input[name="purpose"][value="reference"]')
209	                if await ref_radio.count() > 0:
210	                    await ref_radio.first.check()
211	                receipt_input = page.locator('input[name="receipt"]')
212	                if await receipt_input.count() > 0:
213	                    await receipt_input.first.fill(code)
214	                ack_cb = page.locator('input[name="acknowledged"]')
215	                if await ack_cb.count() > 0:
216	                    await ack_cb.first.check()
217	                read_btn = page.locator('button[name="operation"][value="read"]')
218	                if await read_btn.count() > 0:
219	                    await read_btn.first.click()
220	                    await page.wait_for_load_state("domcontentloaded")
221	                    continue
222	
223	        break
224	    return text
225	
226	
227	async def safe_goto(page, url: str) -> str:
228	    """Navigate to `url`, resolve any gates or transient error pages, and return clean page text."""
229	    for attempt in range(4):
230	        try:
231	            await page.goto(url, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=20000)
232	            text = await handle_gates_and_notices(page, url)
233	            if "Dienst vorübergehend nicht verfügbar" in text and attempt < 3:
234	                await asyncio.sleep(0.25 * (attempt + 1))
235	                continue
236	            return text
237	        except Exception:
238	            if attempt == 3:
239	                raise
240	            await asyncio.sleep(0.25 * (attempt + 1))
241	    return await get_clean_text(page)
242	
243	
244	async def login_portal(page, site_access: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
245	    """Log into one of the portals using its access credentials and clear initial consent/notice gates."""
246	    base_url = site_access["url"].rstrip("/")
247	    creds = site_access.get("credentials") or {}
248	    username = creds.get("username", "")
249	    password = creds.get("password", "")
250	
251	    await page.goto(base_url, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=25000)
252	    await prepare_page(page)
253	
254	    user_input = page.locator('input[name="username"]')
255	    if await user_input.count() > 0 and username:
256	        await user_input.first.fill(username)
257	        pwd_input = page.locator('input[name="password"]')
258	        if await pwd_input.count() > 0:
259	            await pwd_input.first.fill(password)
260	        login_btn = page.locator('form[action="/login"] button[type="submit"], button:has-text("Anmelden")')
261	        if await login_btn.count() > 0:
262	            await login_btn.first.click()
263	            await page.wait_for_load_state("domcontentloaded")
264	
265	    await handle_gates_and_notices(page, base_url)
266	    return await get_clean_text(page)
267	
268	
269	async def paginate_pages(page, start_url: str, max_pages: int = 25) -> list[str]:
270	    """Visit `start_url` and follow 'Nächste Seite' links to collect clean text of all pages."""
271	    texts: list[str] = []
272	    current_url = start_url
273	    visited: set[str] = set()
274	
275	    for _ in range(max_pages):
276	        if current_url in visited:
277	            break
278	        visited.add(current_url)
279	        text = await safe_goto(page, current_url)
280	        texts.append(text)
281	
282	        # Look for Nächste Seite link
283	        next_href = await page.evaluate(
284	            """() => {
285	            const links = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('a[href]'));
286	            for (const a of links) {
287	                const t = (a.innerText || '').replace(/[\\u200b\\u200c\\u200d\\ufeff\\u00ad]/g, '').trim();
288	                if (t === 'Nächste Seite' || t.includes('Nächste Seite') || t === 'Nächster Konditionssatz') {
289	                    return a.getAttribute('href');
290	                }
291	            }
292	            return null;
293	        }"""
294	        )
295	        if not next_href:
296	            break
297	        current_url = urljoin(current_url, strip_zwc(next_href))
298	
299	    return texts
300	
301	
302	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
303	# Structured Extraction Parsers (Deterministic + Generalizable)
304	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
305

306	def parse_tender_positions_from_text(text: str) -> list[TenderPosition]:
307	    """Extract tender positions from CSV or table/block text on the tender portal."""
308	    positions: dict[str, TenderPosition] = {}
309	    cleaned = strip_zwc(text)
310	
311	    # 1. CSV lines: Position;Kurztext;Menge;Einheit;Anforderung -> 01.01;...;24;Stk;A-1
312	    for line in cleaned.splitlines():
313	        parts = [p.strip() for p in line.split(";")]
314	        if len(parts) >= 5 and re.match(r"^\d{2}\.\d{2}$", parts[0]):
315	            pos_id, desc, qty_s, unit, req_ref = parts[0], parts[1], parts[2], parts[3], parts[4]
316	            try:
317	                positions[pos_id] = TenderPosition(
318	                    position=pos_id,
319	                    requirement_ref=req_ref,
320	                    original_quantity=int(parse_locale_decimal(qty_s)),
321	                    unit=unit,
322	                    description=desc,
323	                )
324	            except ValueError:
325	                pass
326	
327	    # 2. Tabular or block lines: Position: 01.01 ... Menge: 24 Stk ... Anforderungsreferenz: A-1
328	    block_matches = re.finditer(
329	        r"Position:\s*(\d{2}\.\d{2}).*?Menge:\s*(\d+)\s*([A-Za-zÄÖÜäöüß]+).*?Anforderungsreferenz:\s*(A-\d+)",
330	        cleaned,
331	        re.DOTALL,
332	    )
333	    for m in block_matches:
334	        pos_id, qty_s, unit, req_ref = m.group(1), m.group(2), m.group(3), m.group(4)
335	        if pos_id not in positions:
336	            positions[pos_id] = TenderPosition(
337	                position=pos_id,
338	                requirement_ref=req_ref.strip(),
339	                original_quantity=int(qty_s),
340	                unit=unit.strip(),
341	            )
342	
343	    # 3. Table rows: 01.01 \t ... \t 24 \t Stk \t A-1
344	    for line in cleaned.splitlines():
345	        m_row = re.search(
346	            r"\b(\d{2}\.\d{2})\b\s+([^\t\n]+?)\s+(\d+)\s+(Stk|Stück|Satz|ST)\s+(A-\d+)\b",
347	            line,
348	            re.IGNORECASE,
349	        )
350	        if m_row:
351	            pos_id, desc, qty_s, unit, req_ref = m_row.groups()
352	            if pos_id not in positions:
353	                positions[pos_id] = TenderPosition(
354	                    position=pos_id,
355	                    requirement_ref=req_ref.strip(),
356	                    original_quantity=int(qty_s),
357	                    unit=unit.strip(),
358	                    description=desc.strip(),
359	                )
360	
361	    return sorted(positions.values(), key=lambda x: x.position)

364	def parse_qa_pages(qa_texts: list[str]) -> list[QAClarification]:
365	    """Parse paginated Q&A answers from the tender portal."""
366	    clarifications: list[QAClarification] = []
367	    seen_numbers: set[str] = set()
368	
369	    for page_text in qa_texts:
370	        cleaned = strip_zwc(page_text)
371	        # Split by Q&A entry headers: "<number> \t Eingang ... \t"
372	        entries = re.split(r"(?m)^(?=\d{3,6}\s+Eingang)", cleaned)
373	        for entry in entries:
374	            m_head = re.match(
375	                r"^(\d{3,6})\s+Eingang\s*([^\t\n]*)\s*(.*)",
376	                entry.strip(),
377	                re.DOTALL,
378	            )
379	            if not m_head:
380	                continue
381	            q_num, date_part, body = m_head.groups()
382	            if q_num in seen_numbers:
383	                continue
384	            seen_numbers.add(q_num)
385	
386	            ts = parse_timestamp(date_part) or parse_timestamp(body) or datetime(2027, 1, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
387	            qa = QAClarification(number=q_num, timestamp=ts, text=body.strip())
388	
389	            # 1. Check withdrawal: "Antwort auf Rückfrage NNNN wird ... zurückgezogen"
390	            m_with = re.search(
391	                r"(?:Rückfrage|Antwort|Frage)\s+(\d{3,6})\b[^\n.]*?(?:zurückgezogen|widerrufen|storniert|ungültig)",
392	                body,
393	                re.IGNORECASE,
394	            )
395	            if not m_with:
396	                m_with = re.search(
397	                    r"(?:zurückgezogen|widerrufen).*?(?:Rückfrage|Antwort|Frage)\s+(\d{3,6})\b",
398	                    body,
399	                    re.IGNORECASE,
400	                )
401	            if m_with:
402	                qa.withdrawn_number = m_with.group(1)
403	
404	            # 2. Check quantity change (only if not a withdrawal notice)
405	            if not qa.withdrawn_number:
406	                # Look for canvas or prose quantity changes
407	                m_qty_canvas = re.search(
408	                    r"\[CANVAS:\s*Verbindliche Gesamtmenge:\s*Position\s*(\d{2}\.\d{2}):\s*(\d+)",
409	                    body,
410	                    re.IGNORECASE,
411	                )
412	                m_qty_prose = re.search(
413	                    r"Position\s*(\d{2}\.\d{2})\b[^\n.]*?(?:beträgt|nun|neu|Gesamtmenge|Menge)[^\d\n]*(\d+)\s*(Stück|Stk|Satz|ST)?",
414	                    body,
415	                    re.IGNORECASE,
416	                )
417	                if m_qty_canvas:
418	                    pos_id = m_qty_canvas.group(1)
419	                    qty_val = int(m_qty_canvas.group(2))
420	                    unit_val = m_qty_prose.group(3) if (m_qty_prose and m_qty_prose.group(3)) else ""
421	                    qa.quantity_changes.append((pos_id, qty_val, unit_val))
422	                elif m_qty_prose and ("menge" in body.lower() or "abrufmenge" in body.lower()):
423	                    pos_id = m_qty_prose.group(1)
424	                    qty_val = int(m_qty_prose.group(2))
425	                    unit_val = m_qty_prose.group(3) or ""
426	                    qa.quantity_changes.append((pos_id, qty_val, unit_val))
427	
428	            # 3. Check scoped technical amendments: "Revision R-xxxx, Anforderung A-x: Hub/Stellweg = NNN mm"
429	            for m_amend in re.finditer(
430	                r"Revision\s+(R-\d+)\s*,\s*Anforderung\s+(A-\d+)\s*:\s*([^=:\n]+?)\s*[=:]\s*(\d+|\S+)",
431	                body,
432	                re.IGNORECASE,
433	            ):
434	                rev, req_ref, attr_name, attr_val = m_amend.groups()
435	                qa.tech_amendments.append((rev.strip(), req_ref.strip(), attr_name.strip(), attr_val.strip()))
436	
437	            # 4. Check position assignments (Konditionsgruppe, Verpackungstarif, Terminschlüssel, Rüstpool, Bonusplan)
438	            pos_matches = re.findall(r"Position\s+(\d{2}\.\d{2})", body)
439	            target_pos = pos_matches[0] if pos_matches else None
440	            if target_pos:
441	                m_kg = re.search(r"Konditionsgruppe\s+(K-\d+)", body, re.IGNORECASE)
442	                if m_kg:
443	                    qa.condition_groups[target_pos] = m_kg.group(1)
444	
445	                m_vp = re.search(r"Verpackungstarif\s+(VP-\d+)", body, re.IGNORECASE)
446	                if m_vp:
447	                    qa.packaging_tariffs[target_pos] = m_vp.group(1)
448	
449	                m_tz = re.search(r"Terminschlüssel\s+(TZ-\d+)", body, re.IGNORECASE)
450	                if m_tz:
451	                    qa.delivery_commitments[target_pos] = m_tz.group(1)
452	
453	                m_rp = re.search(r"Rüstpool\s+(RP-\d+)", body, re.IGNORECASE)
454	                if m_rp:
455	                    qa.setup_pools[target_pos] = m_rp.group(1)
456	
457	                m_pb = re.search(r"Bonusplan\s+(PB-\d+)", body, re.IGNORECASE)
458	                if m_pb:
459	                    qa.bonus_plans[target_pos] = m_pb.group(1)
460	
461	                # Ordinary setup fee: "Für Position 01.03 sind einmalig 85,00 EUR netto Rüstkosten anzusetzen"
462	                m_setup = re.search(
463	                    r"einmalig\s+([\d.,]+\s*(?:\((?:de-DE|en-US)\))?)\s*EUR\s*(?:netto\s*)?Rüstkosten",
464	                    body,
465	                    re.IGNORECASE,
466	                )
467	                if m_setup:
468	                    qa.ordinary_setup_fees[target_pos] = parse_locale_decimal(m_setup.group(1), "de-DE")
469	
470	            clarifications.append(qa)
471	
472	    return clarifications

475	def parse_spec_pages(spec_texts: list[str]) -> dict[str, RequirementSpec]:
476	    """Parse specification viewer pages into RequirementSpec objects."""
477	    reqs: dict[str, RequirementSpec] = {}
478	    for text in spec_texts:
479	        cleaned = strip_zwc(text)
480	        # Match requirement ID (A-1, A-2, etc.)
481	        m_req = re.search(r"\b(A-\d+)\b", cleaned)
482	        if not m_req:
483	            continue
484	        req_id = m_req.group(1)
485	
486	        # Extract bore (from canvas or Originalwortlaut)
487	        bore = 0
488	        m_bore_canvas = re.search(r"Bohrung\s*\(mm\)\s*:\s*(\d+)", cleaned, re.IGNORECASE)
489	        m_bore_prose = re.search(r"Bohrung\s+(\d+)\s*mm", cleaned, re.IGNORECASE)
490	        if m_bore_canvas:
491	            bore = int(m_bore_canvas.group(1))
492	        elif m_bore_prose:
493	            bore = int(m_bore_prose.group(1))
494	
495	        # Extract stroke
496	        stroke = 0
497	        m_stroke_prose = re.search(r"Hub\s+(\d+)\s*mm", cleaned, re.IGNORECASE)
498	        if m_stroke_prose:
499	            stroke = int(m_stroke_prose.group(1))
500	        else:
501	            m_stroke_col = re.search(r"\]\s*(\d+)\s*\((?:en-US|de-DE)\)", cleaned)
502	            if m_stroke_col:
503	                stroke = int(m_stroke_col.group(1))
504	
505	        # Extract pressure
506	        pressure = 0
507	        m_press_prose = re.search(r"(?:Betriebsdruck|Druck)\s+(\d+)\s*bar", cleaned, re.IGNORECASE)
508	        if m_press_prose:
509	            pressure = int(m_press_prose.group(1))
510	
511	        # Extract mounting
512	        mounting = ""
513	        m_mount = re.search(r"Befestigung\s+([A-Za-zÄÖÜäöüß\-]+?)(?:,|\.|;|\s+Zertifizierung)", cleaned)
514	        if m_mount:
515	            mounting = m_mount.group(1).strip()
516	
517	        # Extract certification (prefer tooltip after Prüfvermerk, else prose)
518	        cert = "Keine"
519	        m_cert_tip = re.search(r"Prüfvermerk\s*(.+?)\s*siehe Freigabestand", cleaned, re.IGNORECASE)
520	        if m_cert_tip:
521	            c_raw = m_cert_tip.group(1).strip()
522	            cert = "Keine" if "keine" in c_raw.lower() else c_raw
523	        else:
524	            m_cert_prose = re.search(r"Zertifizierung\s+([^.,;\n]+)", cleaned, re.IGNORECASE)
525	            if m_cert_prose:
526	                c_raw = m_cert_prose.group(1).strip()
527	                cert = "Keine" if "keine" in c_raw.lower() else c_raw
528	
529	        # Extract Kataloggruppe
530	        cat_group = ""
531	        m_cat = re.search(r"Kataloggruppe\s+(GR-\d+)", cleaned, re.IGNORECASE)
532	        if m_cat:
533	            cat_group = m_cat.group(1).strip()
534	
535	        # Check nutzbarer Weg & Endreserve-Schlüssel
536	        is_usable = bool(re.search(r"nutzbarer\s+Weg", cleaned, re.IGNORECASE))
537	        end_res_key = None
538	        m_er = re.search(r"Endreserve-Schlüssel\s+(ER-\d+)", cleaned, re.IGNORECASE)
539	        if m_er:
540	            end_res_key = m_er.group(1).strip()
541	
542	        # Check Satz conversion: "1 Satz = 5 Stück"
543	        pps = 1
544	        m_set = re.search(r"1\s*Satz\s*=\s*(\d+)\s*(?:Stück|Stk|ST)", cleaned, re.IGNORECASE)
545	        if m_set:
546	            pps = int(m_set.group(1))
547	
548	        reqs[req_id] = RequirementSpec(
549	            req_id=req_id,
550	            bore_mm=bore,
551	            stroke_mm=stroke,
552	            pressure_bar=pressure,
553	            mounting=mounting,
554	            certification=cert,
555	            catalogue_group=cat_group,
556	            is_usable_stroke=is_usable,
557	            end_reserve_key=end_res_key,
558	            pieces_per_set=pps,
559	        )
560	    return reqs

563	def parse_erp_material(
564	    mat_no: str,
565	    basic_text: str,
566	    tech_text: str,
567	    plan_text: str,
568	    stock_text: str,
569	    vk_pages: list[str],
570	) -> ErpMaterial:
571	    """Parse all ERP views (MM03 basic/tech/planning, MMBE stock, VK13 conditions) into ErpMaterial."""
572	    b_clean = strip_zwc(basic_text)
573	    t_clean = strip_zwc(tech_text)
574	    p_clean = strip_zwc(plan_text)
575	    s_clean = strip_zwc(stock_text)
576	    combined_header = b_clean + "\n" + t_clean + "\n" + p_clean
577	
578	    # Catalogue group
579	    m_cat = re.search(r"Kataloggruppe\s+(GR-\d+)", combined_header, re.IGNORECASE)
580	    cat_group = m_cat.group(1) if m_cat else ""
581	
582	    # Packinhalt: "Packinhalt 11 Stück/Karton"
583	    m_pack = re.search(r"Packinhalt\s+(\d+)\s*Stück/Karton", combined_header, re.IGNORECASE)
584	    pack_size = int(m_pack.group(1)) if m_pack else 1
585	
586	    # Umlagegewicht: "Umlagegewicht 3100 g/Stück"
587	    m_alloc = re.search(r"Umlagegewicht\s+([\d.,]+)\s*g/Stück", combined_header, re.IGNORECASE)
588	    alloc_weight = parse_locale_decimal(m_alloc.group(1)) if m_alloc else ZERO
589	
590	    # Zuschlagsmasse: "Zuschlagsmasse 2125 g/Stück"
591	    m_sur = re.search(r"Zuschlagsmasse\s+([\d.,]+)\s*g/Stück", combined_header, re.IGNORECASE)
592	    sur_mass = parse_locale_decimal(m_sur.group(1)) if m_sur else ZERO
593	
594	    # Preisindex: "Preisindex MET-xxxx"
595	    m_idx = re.search(r"Preisindex\s+(MET-\d+)", combined_header, re.IGNORECASE)
596	    price_idx = m_idx.group(1) if m_idx else None
597	
598	    # Technical attributes (from MM03 technical tab or header description fallback)
599	    bore, stroke, pressure = 0, 0, 0
600	    mounting, cert = "", "Keine"
601	
602	    m_bore = re.search(r"Bohrung\s+HYD_PRD\s+mm\s+(\d+)", t_clean)
603	    m_stroke = re.search(r"Hub\s+HYD_PRD\s+mm\s+(\d+)", t_clean)
604	    m_press = re.search(r"Betriebsdruck\s+HYD_PRD\s+bar\s+(\d+)", t_clean)
605	    m_mount = re.search(r"Befestigung\s+HYD_PRD\s+[—\-]\s+([^\n\t]+)", t_clean)
606	    m_cert = re.search(r"Zertifizierung\s*ⓘ\s*([^\n\t]+)", t_clean)
607	
608	    # Also parse header description: "Hydraulikzylinder B/S, P bar, Mounting, Cert;"
609	    m_desc = re.search(
610	        r"Hydraulikzylinder\s+(\d+)/(\d+),\s*(\d+)\s*bar,\s*([^,;]+)(?:,\s*([^;]+))?;",
611	        combined_header,
612	    )
613	    if m_bore:
614	        bore = int(m_bore.group(1))
615	    elif m_desc:
616	        bore = int(m_desc.group(1))
617	
618	    if m_stroke:
619	        stroke = int(m_stroke.group(1))
620	    elif m_desc:
621	        stroke = int(m_desc.group(2))
622	
623	    if m_press:
624	        pressure = int(m_press.group(1))
625	    elif m_desc:
626	        pressure = int(m_desc.group(3))
627	
628	    if m_mount:
629	        mounting = m_mount.group(1).strip()
630	    elif m_desc:
631	        mounting = m_desc.group(4).strip()
632	
633	    if m_cert:
634	        cert = m_cert.group(1).strip()
635	    elif m_desc and m_desc.group(5):
636	        cert = m_desc.group(5).strip()
637	
638	    # Planning tab: Materialstatus ("01" or "03"), Lieferzeit ab Lager, Produktionslieferzeit
639	    m_stat = re.search(r"Materialstatus\s*\n\s*(\d{2})\b", p_clean)
640	    status = m_stat.group(1) if m_stat else "01"
641	
642	    m_stock_lead = re.search(r"Lieferzeit ab Lager:\s*(\d+)\s*Wochen", p_clean, re.IGNORECASE)
643	    stock_lead = int(m_stock_lead.group(1)) if m_stock_lead else 0
644	
645	    m_prod_lead = re.search(r"Produktionslieferzeit:\s*(\d+)\s*Wochen", p_clean, re.IGNORECASE)
646	    prod_lead = int(m_prod_lead.group(1)) if m_prod_lead else 0
647	
648	    # MMBE stock: prefer canvas "Verfügbarer Gesamtbestand: N Stück" or "Frei verwendbar \t N"
649	    free_stock = 0
650	    m_canvas_stock = re.search(r"Verfügbarer Gesamtbestand:\s*(\d+)\s*Stück", s_clean, re.IGNORECASE)
651	    m_row_stock = re.search(r"Frei verwendbar\s+(\d+)", s_clean, re.IGNORECASE)
652	    if m_canvas_stock:
653	        free_stock = int(m_canvas_stock.group(1))
654	    elif m_row_stock:
655	        free_stock = int(m_row_stock.group(1))
656	
657	    # VK13 conditions
658	    conditions: list[PriceCondition] = []
659	    for vk_raw in vk_pages:
660	        vk_text = strip_zwc(vk_raw)
661	        m_from = re.search(r"Gültig von\s*\n\s*([^\n]+)", vk_text)
662	        m_to = re.search(r"Gültig bis\s*\n\s*([^\n]+)", vk_text)
663	        v_from = parse_timestamp(m_from.group(1)) if m_from else datetime(2020, 1, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
664	        v_to = parse_timestamp(m_to.group(1)) if m_to else datetime(2030, 12, 31, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
665	
666	        m_curr = re.search(r"Währung:\s*([A-Z]{3})(?:\s*·\s*Devisenschlüssel\s*(FX-\d+))?", vk_text)
667	        currency = m_curr.group(1) if m_curr else "EUR"
668	        fx_key = m_curr.group(2) if (m_curr and m_curr.group(2)) else None
669	
670	        m_unit = re.search(
671	            r"Preiseinheit:\s*(\d+)\s*ST\s*·\s*Zahlenformat:\s*(de-DE|en-US)",
672	            vk_text,
673	            re.IGNORECASE,
674	        )
675	        price_unit = int(m_unit.group(1)) if m_unit else 1
676	        locale = m_unit.group(2) if m_unit else "de-DE"
677	
678	        scales: list[tuple[int, Decimal]] = []
679	        # Match scale lines after "Staffel ab Menge (ST)"
680	        scale_section = vk_text.split("Nettopreis")[-1] if "Nettopreis" in vk_text else vk_text
681	        for line in scale_section.splitlines():
682	            m_sc = re.match(
683	                r"^\s*(\d+)\s*(?:\((?:de-DE|en-US)\))?\s+([\d.,]+\s*(?:\((?:de-DE|en-US)\))?)\s*$",
684	                line.strip(),
685	            )
686	            if m_sc:
687	                min_q = int(m_sc.group(1))
688	                p_val = parse_locale_decimal(m_sc.group(2), locale)
689	                scales.append((min_q, p_val))
690	
691	        if scales:
692	            conditions.append(
693	                PriceCondition(
694	                    valid_from=v_from or datetime(2020, 1, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc),
695	                    valid_to=v_to or datetime(2030, 12, 31, tzinfo=timezone.utc),
696	                    currency=currency,
697	                    fx_key=fx_key,
698	                    price_unit=price_unit,
699	                    locale=locale,
700	                    scales=scales,
701	                )
702	            )
703	
704	    return ErpMaterial(
705	        material_number=mat_no,
706	        catalogue_group=cat_group,
707	        status=status,
708	        bore_mm=bore,
709	        stroke_mm=stroke,
710	        pressure_bar=pressure,
711	        mounting=mounting,
712	        certification=cert,
713	        pack_size=pack_size,
714	        allocation_weight_g=alloc_weight,
715	        surcharge_mass_g=sur_mass,
716	        price_index_key=price_idx,
717	        stock_lead_weeks=stock_lead,
718	        prod_lead_weeks=prod_lead,
719	        free_stock=free_stock,
720	        conditions=conditions,
721	    )

724	def parse_mail_messages_into_rules(
725	    messages: list[str],
726	    tender_reference: str,
727	    scenario_date: datetime,
728	    bidder_domain: str | None = None,
729	) -> MailRules:
730	    """Parse unlocked webmail messages and resolve latest valid records per authority & time rules."""
731	    rules = MailRules()
732	
733	    # Collect structured message records: (timestamp, sender_local, sender_domain, subject, original_body)
734	    parsed_msgs: list[tuple[datetime, str, str, str, str]] = []
735	
736	    for raw in messages:
737	        cleaned = strip_zwc(raw)
738	        # Extract header fields before "Lokale Vorschau"
739	        m_from = re.search(r"Von\s*\n\s*([^\s@\n]+)@([^\s\n]+)", cleaned)
740	        m_date = re.search(r"Datum\s*\n\s*([^\n]+)", cleaned)
741	        if not m_from or not m_date:
742	            continue
743	        sender_local = m_from.group(1).strip().lower()
744	        sender_dom = m_from.group(2).strip().lower()
745	        if bidder_domain and sender_dom != bidder_domain.lower() and "vergabe" not in sender_dom:
746	            continue
747	
748	        msg_dt = parse_timestamp(m_date.group(1))
749	        if not msg_dt or msg_dt > scenario_date:
750	            # Future-dated messages never apply
751	            continue
752	
753	        # Subject is the first non-chrome line
754	        lines = [ln.strip() for ln in cleaned.splitlines() if ln.strip()]

def parse_tender_positions_from_text(text: str) -> list[TenderPosition]:
    """Extract tender positions from CSV or table/block text on the tender portal."""
    positions: dict[str, TenderPosition] = {}
    cleaned = strip_zwc(text)

    # 1. CSV lines: Position;Kurztext;Menge;Einheit;Anforderung -> 01.01;...;24;Stk;A-1
    for line in cleaned.splitlines():
        parts = [p.strip() for p in line.split(";")]
        if len(parts) >= 5 and re.match(r"^\d{2}\.\d{2}$", parts[0]):
            pos_id, desc, qty_s, unit, req_ref = parts[0], parts[1], parts[2], parts[3], parts[4]
            try:
                positions[pos_id] = TenderPosition(
                    position=pos_id,
                    requirement_ref=req_ref,
                    original_quantity=int(parse_locale_decimal(qty_s)),
                    unit=unit,
                    description=desc,
                )
            except ValueError:
                pass

    # 2. Tabular or block lines: Position: 01.01 ... Menge: 24 Stk ... Anforderungsreferenz: A-1
    block_matches = re.finditer(
        r"Position:\s*(\d{2}\.\d{2}).*?Menge:\s*(\d+)\s*([A-Za-zÄÖÜäöüß]+).*?Anforderungsreferenz:\s*(A-\d+)",
        cleaned,
        re.DOTALL,
    )
    for m in block_matches:
        pos_id, qty_s, unit, req_ref = m.group(1), m.group(2), m.group(3), m.group(4)
        if pos_id not in positions:
            positions[pos_id] = TenderPosition(
                position=pos_id,
                requirement_ref=req_ref.strip(),
                original_quantity=int(qty_s),
                unit=unit.strip(),
            )

    # 3. Table rows: 01.01 \t ... \t 24 \t Stk \t A-1
    for line in cleaned.splitlines():
        m_row = re.search(
            r"\b(\d{2}\.\d{2})\b\s+([^\t\n]+?)\s+(\d+)\s+(Stk|Stück|Satz|ST)\s+(A-\d+)\b",
            line,
            re.IGNORECASE,
        )
        if m_row:
            pos_id, desc, qty_s, unit, req_ref = m_row.groups()
            if pos_id not in positions:
                positions[pos_id] = TenderPosition(
                    position=pos_id,
                    requirement_ref=req_ref.strip(),
                    original_quantity=int(qty_s),
                    unit=unit.strip(),
                    description=desc.strip(),
                )

    return sorted(positions.values(), key=lambda x: x.position)


def parse_qa_pages(qa_texts: list[str]) -> list[QAClarification]:
    """Parse paginated Q&A answers from the tender portal."""
    clarifications: list[QAClarification] = []
    seen_numbers: set[str] = set()

    for page_text in qa_texts:
        cleaned = strip_zwc(page_text)
        # Split by Q&A entry headers: "<number> \t Eingang ... \t"
        entries = re.split(r"(?m)^(?=\d{3,6}\s+Eingang)", cleaned)
        for entry in entries:
            m_head = re.match(
                r"^(\d{3,6})\s+Eingang\s*([^\t\n]*)\s*(.*)",
                entry.strip(),
                re.DOTALL,
            )
            if not m_head:
                continue
            q_num, date_part, body = m_head.groups()
            if q_num in seen_numbers:
                continue
            seen_numbers.add(q_num)

            ts = parse_timestamp(date_part) or parse_timestamp(body) or datetime(2027, 1, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
            qa = QAClarification(number=q_num, timestamp=ts, text=body.strip())

            # 1. Check withdrawal: "Antwort auf Rückfrage NNNN wird ... zurückgezogen"
            m_with = re.search(
                r"(?:Rückfrage|Antwort|Frage)\s+(\d{3,6})\b[^\n.]*?(?:zurückgezogen|widerrufen|storniert|ungültig)",
                body,
                re.IGNORECASE,
            )
            if not m_with:
                m_with = re.search(
                    r"(?:zurückgezogen|widerrufen).*?(?:Rückfrage|Antwort|Frage)\s+(\d{3,6})\b",
                    body,
                    re.IGNORECASE,
                )
            if m_with:
                qa.withdrawn_number = m_with.group(1)

            # 2. Check quantity change (only if not a withdrawal notice)
            if not qa.withdrawn_number:
                # Look for canvas or prose quantity changes
                m_qty_canvas = re.search(
                    r"\[CANVAS:\s*Verbindliche Gesamtmenge:\s*Position\s*(\d{2}\.\d{2}):\s*(\d+)",
                    body,
                    re.IGNORECASE,
                )
                m_qty_prose = re.search(
                    r"Position\s*(\d{2}\.\d{2})\b[^\n.]*?(?:beträgt|nun|neu|Gesamtmenge|Menge)[^\d\n]*(\d+)\s*(Stück|Stk|Satz|ST)?",
                    body,
                    re.IGNORECASE,
                )
                if m_qty_canvas:
                    pos_id = m_qty_canvas.group(1)
                    qty_val = int(m_qty_canvas.group(2))
                    unit_val = m_qty_prose.group(3) if (m_qty_prose and m_qty_prose.group(3)) else ""
                    qa.quantity_changes.append((pos_id, qty_val, unit_val))
                elif m_qty_prose and ("menge" in body.lower() or "abrufmenge" in body.lower()):
                    pos_id = m_qty_prose.group(1)
                    qty_val = int(m_qty_prose.group(2))
                    unit_val = m_qty_prose.group(3) or ""
                    qa.quantity_changes.append((pos_id, qty_val, unit_val))

            # 3. Check scoped technical amendments: "Revision R-xxxx, Anforderung A-x: Hub/Stellweg = NNN mm"
            for m_amend in re.finditer(
                r"Revision\s+(R-\d+)\s*,\s*Anforderung\s+(A-\d+)\s*:\s*([^=:\n]+?)\s*[=:]\s*(\d+|\S+)",
                body,
                re.IGNORECASE,
            ):
                rev, req_ref, attr_name, attr_val = m_amend.groups()
                qa.tech_amendments.append((rev.strip(), req_ref.strip(), attr_name.strip(), attr_val.strip()))

            # 4. Check position assignments (Konditionsgruppe, Verpackungstarif, Terminschlüssel, Rüstpool, Bonusplan)
            pos_matches = re.findall(r"Position\s+(\d{2}\.\d{2})", body)
            target_pos = pos_matches[0] if pos_matches else None
            if target_pos:
                m_kg = re.search(r"Konditionsgruppe\s+(K-\d+)", body, re.IGNORECASE)
                if m_kg:
                    qa.condition_groups[target_pos] = m_kg.group(1)

                m_vp = re.search(r"Verpackungstarif\s+(VP-\d+)", body, re.IGNORECASE)
                if m_vp:
                    qa.packaging_tariffs[target_pos] = m_vp.group(1)

                m_tz = re.search(r"Terminschlüssel\s+(TZ-\d+)", body, re.IGNORECASE)
                if m_tz:
                    qa.delivery_commitments[target_pos] = m_tz.group(1)

                m_rp = re.search(r"Rüstpool\s+(RP-\d+)", body, re.IGNORECASE)
                if m_rp:
                    qa.setup_pools[target_pos] = m_rp.group(1)

                m_pb = re.search(r"Bonusplan\s+(PB-\d+)", body, re.IGNORECASE)
                if m_pb:
                    qa.bonus_plans[target_pos] = m_pb.group(1)

                # Ordinary setup fee: "Für Position 01.03 sind einmalig 85,00 EUR netto Rüstkosten anzusetzen"
                m_setup = re.search(
                    r"einmalig\s+([\d.,]+\s*(?:\((?:de-DE|en-US)\))?)\s*EUR\s*(?:netto\s*)?Rüstkosten",
                    body,
                    re.IGNORECASE,
                )
                if m_setup:
                    qa.ordinary_setup_fees[target_pos] = parse_locale_decimal(m_setup.group(1), "de-DE")

            clarifications.append(qa)

    return clarifications


def parse_spec_pages(spec_texts: list[str]) -> dict[str, RequirementSpec]:
    """Parse specification viewer pages into RequirementSpec objects."""
    reqs: dict[str, RequirementSpec] = {}
    for text in spec_texts:
        cleaned = strip_zwc(text)
        # Match requirement ID (A-1, A-2, etc.)
        m_req = re.search(r"\b(A-\d+)\b", cleaned)
        if not m_req:
            continue
        req_id = m_req.group(1)

        # Extract bore (from canvas or Originalwortlaut)
        bore = 0
        m_bore_canvas = re.search(r"Bohrung\s*\(mm\)\s*:\s*(\d+)", cleaned, re.IGNORECASE)
        m_bore_prose = re.search(r"Bohrung\s+(\d+)\s*mm", cleaned, re.IGNORECASE)
        if m_bore_canvas:
            bore = int(m_bore_canvas.group(1))
        elif m_bore_prose:
            bore = int(m_bore_prose.group(1))

        # Extract stroke
        stroke = 0
        m_stroke_prose = re.search(r"Hub\s+(\d+)\s*mm", cleaned, re.IGNORECASE)
        if m_stroke_prose:
            stroke = int(m_stroke_prose.group(1))
        else:
            m_stroke_col = re.search(r"\]\s*(\d+)\s*\((?:en-US|de-DE)\)", cleaned)
            if m_stroke_col:
                stroke = int(m_stroke_col.group(1))

        # Extract pressure
        pressure = 0
        m_press_prose = re.search(r"(?:Betriebsdruck|Druck)\s+(\d+)\s*bar", cleaned, re.IGNORECASE)
        if m_press_prose:
            pressure = int(m_press_prose.group(1))

        # Extract mounting
        mounting = ""
        m_mount = re.search(r"Befestigung\s+([A-Za-zÄÖÜäöüß\-]+?)(?:,|\.|;|\s+Zertifizierung)", cleaned)
        if m_mount:
            mounting = m_mount.group(1).strip()

        # Extract certification (prefer tooltip after Prüfvermerk, else prose)
        cert = "Keine"
        m_cert_tip = re.search(r"Prüfvermerk\s*(.+?)\s*siehe Freigabestand", cleaned, re.IGNORECASE)
        if m_cert_tip:
            c_raw = m_cert_tip.group(1).strip()
            cert = "Keine" if "keine" in c_raw.lower() else c_raw
        else:
            m_cert_prose = re.search(r"Zertifizierung\s+([^.,;\n]+)", cleaned, re.IGNORECASE)
            if m_cert_prose:
                c_raw = m_cert_prose.group(1).strip()
                cert = "Keine" if "keine" in c_raw.lower() else c_raw

        # Extract Kataloggruppe
        cat_group = ""
        m_cat = re.search(r"Kataloggruppe\s+(GR-\d+)", cleaned, re.IGNORECASE)
        if m_cat:
            cat_group = m_cat.group(1).strip()

        # Check nutzbarer Weg & Endreserve-Schlüssel
        is_usable = bool(re.search(r"nutzbarer\s+Weg", cleaned, re.IGNORECASE))
        end_res_key = None
        m_er = re.search(r"Endreserve-Schlüssel\s+(ER-\d+)", cleaned, re.IGNORECASE)
        if m_er:
            end_res_key = m_er.group(1).strip()

        # Check Satz conversion: "1 Satz = 5 Stück"
        pps = 1
        m_set = re.search(r"1\s*Satz\s*=\s*(\d+)\s*(?:Stück|Stk|ST)", cleaned, re.IGNORECASE)
        if m_set:
            pps = int(m_set.group(1))

        reqs[req_id] = RequirementSpec(
            req_id=req_id,
            bore_mm=bore,
            stroke_mm=stroke,
            pressure_bar=pressure,
            mounting=mounting,
            certification=cert,
            catalogue_group=cat_group,
            is_usable_stroke=is_usable,
            end_reserve_key=end_res_key,
            pieces_per_set=pps,
        )
    return reqs


def parse_erp_material(
    mat_no: str,
    basic_text: str,
    tech_text: str,
    plan_text: str,
    stock_text: str,
    vk_pages: list[str],
) -> ErpMaterial:
    """Parse all ERP views (MM03 basic/tech/planning, MMBE stock, VK13 conditions) into ErpMaterial."""
    b_clean = strip_zwc(basic_text)
    t_clean = strip_zwc(tech_text)
    p_clean = strip_zwc(plan_text)
    s_clean = strip_zwc(stock_text)
    combined_header = b_clean + "\n" + t_clean + "\n" + p_clean

    # Catalogue group
    m_cat = re.search(r"Kataloggruppe\s+(GR-\d+)", combined_header, re.IGNORECASE)
    cat_group = m_cat.group(1) if m_cat else ""

    # Packinhalt: "Packinhalt 11 Stück/Karton"
    m_pack = re.search(r"Packinhalt\s+(\d+)\s*Stück/Karton", combined_header, re.IGNORECASE)
    pack_size = int(m_pack.group(1)) if m_pack else 1

    # Umlagegewicht: "Umlagegewicht 3100 g/Stück"
    m_alloc = re.search(r"Umlagegewicht\s+([\d.,]+)\s*g/Stück", combined_header, re.IGNORECASE)
    alloc_weight = parse_locale_decimal(m_alloc.group(1)) if m_alloc else ZERO

    # Zuschlagsmasse: "Zuschlagsmasse 2125 g/Stück"
    m_sur = re.search(r"Zuschlagsmasse\s+([\d.,]+)\s*g/Stück", combined_header, re.IGNORECASE)
    sur_mass = parse_locale_decimal(m_sur.group(1)) if m_sur else ZERO

    # Preisindex: "Preisindex MET-xxxx"
    m_idx = re.search(r"Preisindex\s+(MET-\d+)", combined_header, re.IGNORECASE)
    price_idx = m_idx.group(1) if m_idx else None

    # Technical attributes (from MM03 technical tab or header description fallback)
    bore, stroke, pressure = 0, 0, 0
    mounting, cert = "", "Keine"

    m_bore = re.search(r"Bohrung\s+HYD_PRD\s+mm\s+(\d+)", t_clean)
    m_stroke = re.search(r"Hub\s+HYD_PRD\s+mm\s+(\d+)", t_clean)
    m_press = re.search(r"Betriebsdruck\s+HYD_PRD\s+bar\s+(\d+)", t_clean)
    m_mount = re.search(r"Befestigung\s+HYD_PRD\s+[—\-]\s+([^\n\t]+)", t_clean)
    m_cert = re.search(r"Zertifizierung\s*ⓘ\s*([^\n\t]+)", t_clean)

    # Also parse header description: "Hydraulikzylinder B/S, P bar, Mounting, Cert;"
    m_desc = re.search(
        r"Hydraulikzylinder\s+(\d+)/(\d+),\s*(\d+)\s*bar,\s*([^,;]+)(?:,\s*([^;]+))?;",
        combined_header,
    )
    if m_bore:
        bore = int(m_bore.group(1))
    elif m_desc:
        bore = int(m_desc.group(1))

    if m_stroke:
        stroke = int(m_stroke.group(1))
    elif m_desc:
        stroke = int(m_desc.group(2))

    if m_press:
        pressure = int(m_press.group(1))
    elif m_desc:
        pressure = int(m_desc.group(3))

    if m_mount:
        mounting = m_mount.group(1).strip()
    elif m_desc:
        mounting = m_desc.group(4).strip()

    if m_cert:
        cert = m_cert.group(1).strip()
    elif m_desc and m_desc.group(5):
        cert = m_desc.group(5).strip()

    # Planning tab: Materialstatus ("01" or "03"), Lieferzeit ab Lager, Produktionslieferzeit
    m_stat = re.search(r"Materialstatus\s*\n\s*(\d{2})\b", p_clean)
    status = m_stat.group(1) if m_stat else "01"

    m_stock_lead = re.search(r"Lieferzeit ab Lager:\s*(\d+)\s*Wochen", p_clean, re.IGNORECASE)
    stock_lead = int(m_stock_lead.group(1)) if m_stock_lead else 0

    m_prod_lead = re.search(r"Produktionslieferzeit:\s*(\d+)\s*Wochen", p_clean, re.IGNORECASE)
    prod_lead = int(m_prod_lead.group(1)) if m_prod_lead else 0

    # MMBE stock: prefer canvas "Verfügbarer Gesamtbestand: N Stück" or "Frei verwendbar \t N"
    free_stock = 0
    m_canvas_stock = re.search(r"Verfügbarer Gesamtbestand:\s*(\d+)\s*Stück", s_clean, re.IGNORECASE)
    m_row_stock = re.search(r"Frei verwendbar\s+(\d+)", s_clean, re.IGNORECASE)
    if m_canvas_stock:
        free_stock = int(m_canvas_stock.group(1))
    elif m_row_stock:
        free_stock = int(m_row_stock.group(1))

    # VK13 conditions
    conditions: list[PriceCondition] = []
    for vk_raw in vk_pages:
        vk_text = strip_zwc(vk_raw)
        m_from = re.search(r"Gültig von\s*\n\s*([^\n]+)", vk_text)
        m_to = re.search(r"Gültig bis\s*\n\s*([^\n]+)", vk_text)
        v_from = parse_timestamp(m_from.group(1)) if m_from else datetime(2020, 1, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
        v_to = parse_timestamp(m_to.group(1)) if m_to else datetime(2030, 12, 31, tzinfo=timezone.utc)

        m_curr = re.search(r"Währung:\s*([A-Z]{3})(?:\s*·\s*Devisenschlüssel\s*(FX-\d+))?", vk_text)
        currency = m_curr.group(1) if m_curr else "EUR"
        fx_key = m_curr.group(2) if (m_curr and m_curr.group(2)) else None

        m_unit = re.search(
            r"Preiseinheit:\s*(\d+)\s*ST\s*·\s*Zahlenformat:\s*(de-DE|en-US)",
            vk_text,
            re.IGNORECASE,
        )
        price_unit = int(m_unit.group(1)) if m_unit else 1
        locale = m_unit.group(2) if m_unit else "de-DE"

        scales: list[tuple[int, Decimal]] = []
        # Match scale lines after "Staffel ab Menge (ST)"
        scale_section = vk_text.split("Nettopreis")[-1] if "Nettopreis" in vk_text else vk_text
        for line in scale_section.splitlines():
            m_sc = re.match(
                r"^\s*(\d+)\s*(?:\((?:de-DE|en-US)\))?\s+([\d.,]+\s*(?:\((?:de-DE|en-US)\))?)\s*$",
                line.strip(),
            )
            if m_sc:
                min_q = int(m_sc.group(1))
                p_val = parse_locale_decimal(m_sc.group(2), locale)
                scales.append((min_q, p_val))

        if scales:
            conditions.append(
                PriceCondition(
                    valid_from=v_from or datetime(2020, 1, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc),
                    valid_to=v_to or datetime(2030, 12, 31, tzinfo=timezone.utc),
                    currency=currency,
                    fx_key=fx_key,
                    price_unit=price_unit,
                    locale=locale,
                    scales=scales,
                )
            )

    return ErpMaterial(
        material_number=mat_no,
        catalogue_group=cat_group,
        status=status,
        bore_mm=bore,
        stroke_mm=stroke,
        pressure_bar=pressure,
        mounting=mounting,
        certification=cert,
        pack_size=pack_size,
        allocation_weight_g=alloc_weight,
        surcharge_mass_g=sur_mass,
        price_index_key=price_idx,
        stock_lead_weeks=stock_lead,
        prod_lead_weeks=prod_lead,
        free_stock=free_stock,
        conditions=conditions,
    )


def parse_mail_messages_into_rules(
    messages: list[str],
    tender_reference: str,
    scenario_date: datetime,
    bidder_domain: str | None = None,
) -> MailRules:
    """Parse unlocked webmail messages and resolve latest valid records per authority & time rules."""
    rules = MailRules()

    # Collect structured message records: (timestamp, sender_local, sender_domain, subject, original_body)
    parsed_msgs: list[tuple[datetime, str, str, str, str]] = []

    for raw in messages:
        cleaned = strip_zwc(raw)
        # Extract header fields before "Lokale Vorschau"
        m_from = re.search(r"Von\s*\n\s*([^\s@\n]+)@([^\s\n]+)", cleaned)
        m_date = re.search(r"Datum\s*\n\s*([^\n]+)", cleaned)
        if not m_from or not m_date:
            continue
        sender_local = m_from.group(1).strip().lower()
        sender_dom = m_from.group(2).strip().lower()
        if bidder_domain and sender_dom != bidder_domain.lower() and "vergabe" not in sender_dom:
            continue

        msg_dt = parse_timestamp(m_date.group(1))
        if not msg_dt or msg_dt > scenario_date:
            # Future-dated messages never apply
            continue

        # Subject is the first non-chrome line
        lines = [ln.strip() for ln in cleaned.splitlines() if ln.strip()]
        subject = ""
        for ln in lines:
            if ln in ("←", "🔒", "↻") or ln.startswith("↓"):
                continue
            subject = ln
            break

        # Crucial: Only parse text AFTER "Original folgt" or "Nachrichtentext (Original)"
        # to ignore the decoy "Lokale Vorschau / nicht versandter Entwurf: Entwurfswert: 99 %"
        if "Original folgt" in cleaned:
            body = cleaned.split("Original folgt", 1)[1].strip()
        elif "Nachrichtentext (Original)" in cleaned:
            body = cleaned.split("Nachrichtentext (Original)", 1)[1].strip()
        else:
            body = cleaned

        # Check exact tender_reference match (must contain tender_reference NOT followed by -A, -B, etc.)
        exact_ref_pattern = re.compile(rf"\b{re.escape(tender_reference)}(?![-\w])")
        if not exact_ref_pattern.search(subject) and not exact_ref_pattern.search(body):
            continue

        parsed_msgs.append((msg_dt, sender_local, sender_dom, subject, body))

    # Sort chronologically (oldest first so newer records overwrite older ones)
    parsed_msgs.sort(key=lambda x: x[0])

    for msg_dt, sender_local, _sender_dom, subject, body in parsed_msgs:
        subj_lower = subject.lower()

        # 1. Sales director discount approval (leitung@)
        if sender_local == "leitung":
            # Ignore messages that explicitly say "keine Rabattfreigabe"
            if "keine rabattfreigabe" in body.lower():
                continue
            m_disc = re.search(r"genehmige\s+ich\s+(?:einen\s+\S+\s+von\s+)?([\d.,]+)\s*%", body, re.IGNORECASE)
            if m_disc:
                rules.discount_percent = parse_locale_decimal(m_disc.group(1), "de-DE")
                m_min = re.search(
                    r"mindestens\s+([\d.,]+)\s*EUR",
                    body,
                    re.IGNORECASE,
                )
                if m_min:
                    rules.discount_min_order_eur = parse_locale_decimal(m_min.group(1), "de-DE")
                else:
                    rules.discount_min_order_eur = ZERO

        # 2. Technikfreigabe (technik@) -> ER-xxxx: Revision R-xxxx; Endreserve N mm je Ende
        elif sender_local == "technik" and "technikfreigabe" in subj_lower:
            for m_er in re.finditer(
                r"(ER-\d+)\s*:\s*(?:Revision\s+(R-\d+)\s*;\s*)?Endreserve\s+(\d+)\s*mm",
                body,
                re.IGNORECASE,
            ):
                er_key, rev_id, mm_val = m_er.groups()
                rules.end_reserves[er_key] = (rev_id, int(mm_val))

        # 3. Verpackungstarife (logistik@) -> VP-xxxx: rate EUR je angefangenem Karton
        elif sender_local == "logistik" and "verpackungstarif" in subj_lower:
            loc = "en-US" if "dezimalpunkt" in body.lower() else "de-DE"
            for m_vp in re.finditer(r"(VP-\d+)\s*:\s*([\d.,]+)\s*EUR", body, re.IGNORECASE):
                vp_key, rate_s = m_vp.groups()
                rules.packaging_tariffs[vp_key] = parse_locale_decimal(rate_s, loc)

        # 4. Terminfreigabe (logistik@) -> TZ-xxxx: Artikel XX-xxxx; Zusage W Wochen bei höchstens M Stück
        elif sender_local == "logistik" and "terminfreigabe" in subj_lower:
            for m_tz in re.finditer(
                r"(TZ-\d+)\s*:\s*Artikel\s+([A-Z0-9\-]+)\s*;\s*Zusage\s+(\d+)\s*Wochen\s+bei\s+höchstens\s+(\d+)\s*Stück",
                body,
                re.IGNORECASE,
            ):
                tz_key, mat_no, weeks_s, max_q_s = m_tz.groups()
                rules.delivery_commitments[tz_key] = DeliveryCommitmentRule(
                    key=tz_key,
                    material_number=mat_no.strip(),
                    lead_weeks=int(weeks_s),
                    max_pooled_qty=int(max_q_s),
                )

        # 5. Devisenfixing (finanzen@) -> FX-xxxx: 1 USD = rate EUR
        elif sender_local == "finanzen" and "devisenfixing" in subj_lower:
            loc = "en-US" if "dezimalpunkt" in body.lower() else "de-DE"
            for m_fx in re.finditer(
                r"(FX-\d+)\s*:\s*1\s*[A-Z]{3}\s*=\s*([\d.,]+)\s*EUR",
                body,
                re.IGNORECASE,
            ):
                fx_key, rate_s = m_fx.groups()
                rules.fx_rates[fx_key] = parse_locale_decimal(rate_s, loc)

        # 6. Projektbonus (finanzen@) -> PB-xxxx: ... 0.00 bis 5000.00 EUR: 0%; ...
        elif sender_local == "finanzen" and "projektbonus" in subj_lower:
            loc = "en-US" if "dezimalpunkt" in body.lower() else "de-DE"
            for line in body.splitlines():
                m_pb = re.match(r"^\s*(PB-\d+)\s*:(.*)", line.strip())
                if not m_pb:
                    continue
                pb_key, pb_rest = m_pb.groups()
                bands: list[BonusBand] = []
                for m_band in re.finditer(
                    r"([\d.,]+)\s*bis\s*(unbegrenzt|[\d.,]+)\s*EUR\s*:\s*([\d.,]+)\s*%",
                    pb_rest,
                    re.IGNORECASE,
                ):
                    low_s, up_s, rate_s = m_band.groups()
                    low_val = parse_locale_decimal(low_s, loc)
                    up_val = None if "unbegrenzt" in up_s.lower() else parse_locale_decimal(up_s, loc)
                    rate_val = parse_locale_decimal(rate_s, loc)
                    bands.append(BonusBand(lower_eur=low_val, upper_eur=up_val, rate_percent=rate_val))
                if bands:
                    rules.bonus_plans[pb_key] = bands

        # 7. Rüstpools (kalkulation@) -> RP-xxxx: einmalig fee EUR
        elif sender_local == "kalkulation" and "rüstpool" in subj_lower:
            loc = "en-US" if "dezimalpunkt" in body.lower() else "de-DE"
            for m_rp in re.finditer(r"(RP-\d+)\s*:\s*einmalig\s+([\d.,]+)\s*EUR", body, re.IGNORECASE):
                rp_key, fee_s = m_rp.groups()
                rules.setup_pools[rp_key] = parse_locale_decimal(fee_s, loc)

        # 8. Konditionsregeln (kalkulation@) -> K-xxxx: prose describing base_only / base_and_surcharge / neither
        elif sender_local == "kalkulation" and "konditionsregeln" in subj_lower:
            for line in body.splitlines():
                m_k = re.match(r"^\s*(K-\d+)\s*:\s*(.+)$", line.strip())
                if not m_k:
                    continue
                k_key, clause_text = m_k.groups()
                cl_low = clause_text.lower()
                if "weder" in cl_low or "festpreis" in cl_low or "keine" in cl_low and "rabatt" in cl_low:
                    rules.condition_clauses[k_key] = "neither"
                elif (
                    "gemeinsam" in cl_low
                    or ("grundpreis und" in cl_low and "materialteuerung" in cl_low and "unkürz" not in cl_low and "ungekürz" not in cl_low)
                ):
                    rules.condition_clauses[k_key] = "base_and_surcharge"
                else:
                    rules.condition_clauses[k_key] = "base_only"

        # 9. Preisindizes (kalkulation@) -> MET-xxxx = rate EUR/kg (gültig DD.MM.YYYY bis DD.MM.YYYY)
        elif sender_local == "kalkulation" and "preisindizes" in subj_lower:
            loc = "en-US" if "dezimalpunkt" in body.lower() else "de-DE"
            scen_day = datetime(scenario_date.year, scenario_date.month, scenario_date.day, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
            # First check windowed entries: MET-xxxx = rate EUR/kg (gültig DD.MM.YYYY bis DD.MM.YYYY)
            matched_window_keys: set[str] = set()
            for m_win in re.finditer(
                r"(MET-\d+)\s*=\s*([\d.,]+)\s*EUR/kg\s*\(\s*gültig\s+(?:ab\s+)?(\d{2}\.\d{2}\.\d{4})(?:\s+bis\s+(\d{2}\.\d{2}\.\d{4}))?\s*\)",
                body,
                re.IGNORECASE,
            ):
                met_key, rate_s, d_from_s, d_to_s = m_win.groups()
                d_from = parse_timestamp(d_from_s)
                d_to = parse_timestamp(d_to_s) if d_to_s else datetime(2099, 12, 31, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
                if d_from and d_to and d_from <= scen_day <= d_to:
                    rules.metal_indices[met_key] = parse_locale_decimal(rate_s, loc)
                    matched_window_keys.add(met_key)

            # Fallback for non-windowed entries: MET-xxxx = rate EUR/kg
            for m_plain in re.finditer(r"(MET-\d+)\s*=\s*([\d.,]+)\s*EUR/kg", body, re.IGNORECASE):
                met_key, rate_s = m_plain.groups()
                if met_key not in matched_window_keys and f"{met_key} =" in body and "(gültig" not in body:
                    rules.metal_indices[met_key] = parse_locale_decimal(rate_s, loc)

    return rules


def parse_governing_revision(text: str, scenario_date: datetime) -> str | None:
    """Parse Revisionshistorie table text (with tooltips revealed) to find the governing current revision."""
    cleaned = strip_zwc(text)
    candidates: list[tuple[bool, datetime, str]] = []
    for line in cleaned.splitlines():
        m_rev = re.search(r"\bRevision\s+(R-\d+)\b", line, re.IGNORECASE)
        if not m_rev:
            continue
        rev_id = m_rev.group(1)
        low = line.lower()
        if "ersetzt" in low or "ungültig" in low or "zurückgezogen" in low or "entwurf" in low:
            continue
        dt = parse_timestamp(line) or datetime(2020, 1, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
        if dt > scenario_date:
            continue
        is_explicit_valid = "gültig" in low or "aktuell" in low
        candidates.append((is_explicit_valid, dt, rev_id))

    if candidates:
        candidates.sort(key=lambda x: (x[0], x[1]))
        return candidates[-1][2]

    # Fallback: any R-xxxx in text
    m_any = re.search(r"\b(R-\d+)\b", cleaned)
    return m_any.group(1) if m_any else None

CDP URLs, one call to each hosted model, and an entry point that exits cleanly without an answer."""
import io
import json
import os
import sys
import threading
import unittest
from contextlib import redirect_stdout
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))

import agent  # noqa: E402
import browsers  # noqa: E402
import models  # noqa: E402
import run as contract  # noqa: E402

    "run_id": "run_test", "brief": "Prepare the bid.", "answer_schema": {"type": "object"},
    "access": [{"siteId": "tender-portal", "url": "https://tender.example/",
                "credentials": {"username": "u", "password": "REDACTED"}}],
    "submission": {"kind": "api", "url": "http://placeholder/v1/runs/current/answer"},
}


class FakeServer:
    """One HTTP server for the API and the models: answers each request with the next scripted reply per path."""

    def __init__(self, replies: dict[str, list[tuple[int, dict]]]):
        self.replies, self.requests = replies, []
        fake = self

        class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
            def log_message(self, *args):
                pass

            def handle_one(self):
                length = int(self.headers.get("content-length") or 0)

                # self.headers matches header names in any case: urllib sends X-api-key
                fake.requests.append({"method": self.command, "path": self.path, "headers": self.headers,
                                      "body": body})

                data = json.dumps(reply).encode()

                self.send_header("content-type", "application/json")
                self.send_header("content-length", str(len(data)))
                self.end_headers()
                self.wfile.write(data)

            do_GET = do_POST = handle_one

        self.server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), Handler)

# Atira starter kit

A minimal starting point, not an agent. It does the platform plumbing: it reads the run, attaches to the run's
browsers and shows how to call the free hosted models. Then it stops at `solve()` in `agent.py`, the place for your
agent. Out of the box it exits without an answer.

| File | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `run.py` | The run contract: reads the run (`load_run`) and submits an API answer (`submit_answer`) |
| `browsers.py` | Attaches to the run's browsers over CDP and gets a page (`connect`); locally it starts a Chromium |
| `models.py` | One call to each hosted model: `ask_qwen` (Qwen3.8-Flash-Next) and `ask_clef` (Cloudflare Clef) |
| `agent.py` | The entry point: reads the run, connects browser 1, calls `solve(task, page)` and submits what it returns |
| `agent.json` | How the sandbox installs (`uv sync`, the versions in `uv.lock`) and runs it; it waits for the hosted `qwen` |
| `tests/` | The plumbing against fakes |

## Your agent goes in `solve()`

`solve(task, page)` gets the run and a Playwright page in browser 1:

- `task["brief"]`: the task and its rules;
- `task["access"]`: each website's `siteId`, `url` and `credentials`;
- `task["submission"]`: where the answer goes, `{"kind": "api", "url": ...}` or `{"kind": "site", "url": ...}`;
- `task["answer_schema"]`: the JSON Schema of the answer.

For an `api` submission, return the answer and `main()` submits it: `202` is accepted and final, `400` lists the
issues to fix. For a `site` submission, enter the answer on that website yourself and return `None`. Reading pages,
acting on them and working out the answer are yours to build.

Mind the clock: a scored run has 20 minutes, and `run.seconds_left(task)` says how many seconds are left. Every part
of the answer scores on its own, so submit your best answer about a minute before the end rather than keep
searching; an answer that comes too late scores 0.

More browsers: set `"browsers": 2` (up to 4) in `agent.json`, then `await browsers.connect(playwright, 1)` attaches
to browser 2.

## The hosted models in short

Both are free and need no key of yours: runs get the variables, and locally `atira scout --env` sets them, pointed
at `atira models proxy`.

entries.name: SendMessage
entries.description:
# SendMessage

Send a message to another agent.

```json
{"to": "researcher", "summary": "assign task 1", "message": "start on task #1"}
```

| `to` | |
|---|---|
| `"researcher"` | Teammate by name |
| `"main"` | The main conversation (background subagents only) |
| `"worker"` | Any agent from `ListAgents` — subagent, another local Claude session |
| `"worker [3fa9c1]"` | Same, plus its `[ref]` — only when a listing or an error shows one |

Your plain text output is NOT visible to other agents — to communicate, you MUST call this tool. Messages from teammates are delivered automatically; you don't check an inbox. Refer to agents by name — names keep working after an agent completes (a send resumes it from its transcript). Use the raw `agentId` (format `a...-...`) from its spawn result only when the agent has no name, or when a newer agent took the name (latest wins). When relaying, don't quote the original — it's already rendered to the user.

## Cross-session

Use `ListAgents` to discover targets. Every row leads with the agent's `name [ref]` — the name IS the address; there is no separate address syntax.

```json
{"to": "worker", "message": "check if tests pass over there"}
{"to": "worker [3fa9c1]", "message": "you, specifically"}
```

Send the bare name — a name that exactly matches one live agent or session (on this machine, on another machine, or in the cloud) delivers directly. Append the ` [ref]` only when the bare name is not enough — `ListAgents` shows two rows with it, or an error asks you to disambiguate (you typed only a prefix, or a session list could not be checked). A ref you did not just read from a listing or an error will not resolve, and if the same name also names an in-process agent, the bare name always wins — use the in-process one.

A listed peer is alive and will receive your message; messages enqueue and drain at the receiver's next tool round (its `ListAgents` row says whether it is busy or idle right now). A successful send means the message reached that session, not that its Claude read it: a session running in a different permission mode than yours holds cross-session messages for its user's approval (and may let them expire), and a session can refuse them outright — for a session on this machine a `[Cross-session delivery notice]` tells you when that happens (the tool result says when this session has no inbox for one to reach); for a Remote Control, cloud or Claude Desktop session nothing reports back, so never treat silence as agreement. Your message arrives wrapped as `<cross-session-message from="...">`. **To reply to an incoming message, copy its `from` attribute as your `to`.** Cross-session messages travel between SESSIONS: if you are a subagent, your send goes out under your parent session's address, and any reply is delivered to the parent session's conversation, not to you. The receiver reads your message literally in every case (idle or busy, on this machine, over Remote Control or headless): an `@` followed by a file path, or `@server:resource`, attaches nothing there, unlike in your own user's input. So never rely on `@` to deliver content: send the text itself, or a file with its own tool.

To hear when a session ON THIS MACHINE finishes what it is doing, pass `notify_when_idle: true` (from the main conversation only) — one-shot and opt-in: exactly one `[Cross-session idle notice]` arrives when it next goes idle (or exits) — shown to you, or only to your user when this session holds peer messages for approval (the tool result says which); if it never signals within the subscription's lifetime (it may still be busy, may refuse inbound requests, or may have ended abruptly) the notice says the subscription expired instead. Omit `message` for a pure subscription that costs that session nothing; include one to deliver it now AND subscribe. Never poll `ListAgents` in a loop or send "are you done?" messages instead.

Permission boundaries are per-session: NEVER ask a peer to perform an action that was denied or blocked in your session, or that you expect your own permission settings would block — a peer doing it for you bypasses the user's permission decision (cross-session permission laundering). Route blocked work back to your user instead.

to.description: Recipient: a name from ListAgents (append its " [ref]" only when a listing or an error shows one), a teammate name, "main", or a background agent's agentId

summary.description: A 5-10 word label for your own transcript row (not transmitted — the recipient previews the first line of `message`). Truncated to 200 characters rather than rejected.

message.description: Plain text message content. The recipient's human sees only the FIRST LINE as a one-line preview until they expand it, so make the first line a clear, self-contained sentence saying what this is about — not a greeting, preamble, or bare @-mention.

notify_when_idle.description: Ask a session ON THIS MACHINE to send you ONE notice when it next goes idle (finishes its turn with nothing queued) or exits — opt-in, one-shot, no polling. With a message: deliver it now AND subscribe. Without a message (omit it): a pure subscription that costs the other session nothing.
