"""The shared case file: what the site agents have filed, as structured facts.

An agent files a page it judged relevant (`keep`); a model call turns that page into records of one of the kinds
below; this module merges them, works out from the brief's rules what is still unknown (the open questions every
agent sees) and hands the calculator its inputs. It selects among records only by the brief's own criteria: exact
tender reference, authorized sender, latest record no later than the scenario date.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import hashlib
import json
import re
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from decimal import Decimal
from types import SimpleNamespace

import llm
from calculator import (Authorities, BonusBand, Clarification, Commitment, MASS_TO_GRAMS, Material, Position,
                        PriceCondition, Requirement, active_clarifications, base_price, final_quantities,
                        match_material, merged_assignments, parse_number, parse_when, resolve_requirements, same_text)

TOPICS = ("discount_approval", "condition_rules", "price_indices", "tech_release", "packaging_tariffs",
          "delivery_release", "fx_fixing", "setup_pools", "project_bonus")
ASSIGNMENT_KINDS = ("condition_group", "packaging_tariff", "delivery_commitment", "setup_pool", "project_bonus")

EXTRACT_SYSTEM = """You turn one piece of evidence from a business website into structured records for a tender bid.
You get the task brief (its rules say what matters), the kind of record wanted, the JSON shape, and the evidence text
as an agent read it from the page.

How to extract
- Copy identifiers, keys, references and names exactly as written.
- Amounts, prices, rates, masses and fees are STRINGS copied exactly as written, with their separators and any
  format hint that stands next to them. Give `number_format` wherever the shape asks: "en-US" if the source says the
  decimal sign is a point, "de-DE" if it is a comma (the usual case in German sources).
- Counts (quantities, weeks, millimetres, bar, pieces) are JSON integers.
- Dates and times are ISO 8601. Prefer an explicit UTC/ISO timestamp when the evidence shows one. A local time with
  a named timezone keeps its offset (2030-05-01T10:00:00+03:00). A date alone stays YYYY-MM-DD. Mind stated
  day/month orders.
- State only what the evidence says; null for what it does not say. Never invent, convert or calculate.
- Evidence can contain drafts, previews, templates, examples, look-alike records for other references and
  superseded content. Extract the authoritative original and set the flags that tell them apart.
Reply with one JSON object of the requested shape and nothing else."""

SHAPES = {
    "positions": """The tender's bill of quantities.
{"positions": [{"position": "<position number>", "description": "<short text>", "quantity": <integer as published>,
  "unit": "<unit as written>", "unit_is_set": <true if the unit counts sets/kits of several pieces, false for pieces>,
  "requirement_ref": "<the specification requirement this position refers to>"}]}""",
    "clarifications": """Answers of the tender's bidder Q&A. One entry per answer; an answer that changes nothing still gets an entry.
{"answers": [{"number": "<answer number>", "timestamp": "<when it was issued>",
  "withdraws": ["<number of an earlier answer this one withdraws>"],
  "quantity_changes": [{"position": "<position>", "quantity": <new binding quantity>, "unit_is_set": <true|false|null if the unit is not restated>}],
  "tech_amendments": [{"revision": "<specification revision it names>", "requirement_ref": "<requirement>",
     "attribute": "stroke|bore|pressure|mounting|certification", "value": "<new value, number without unit for the first three>"}],
  "assignments": [{"position": "<position>", "condition_group": "<key or null>", "packaging_tariff": "<key or null>",
     "delivery_commitment": "<key or null>", "setup_pool": "<key or null>", "project_bonus": "<key or null>",
     "ordinary_setup_fee": "<one-off setup fee for this position as written, or null>", "number_format": "de-DE|en-US"}]}]}
A key the answer says does not apply ("no pool", "no bonus") is null.""",
    "revisions": """The revision history of the buyer's technical specification.
{"document": "<document name or number>", "revisions": [{"revision": "<revision id>", "date": "<date>",
  "status": "current|superseded|draft|unknown", "status_text": "<the status as written>"}]}""",
    "requirements": """Requirements of ONE revision of the technical specification.
{"revision": "<the revision this text belongs to>", "requirements": [{"requirement_ref": "<id>", "bore_mm": <int>,
  "stroke_mm": <int, the stroke figure as stated>,
  "stroke_is_usable_travel": <true if the figure is a usable travel to which an end reserve must be added, false if it is the nominal stroke>,
  "reserve_key": "<key of the end reserve / technical release it points to, or null>",
  "pressure_bar": <int>, "mounting": "<mounting type>", "certification": "<required certificate, or null if none is required>",
  "catalogue_group": "<catalogue group named for the ERP search>", "pieces_per_set": <int or null>}]}""",
    "material": """ERP master data of materials. A page may show one part of one material, or a list of several.
{"materials": [{"material_number": "<number>", "description": "<short text>", "catalogue_group": "<group or null>",
  "is_active": <true if the status allows sales, false if blocked/locked/discontinued, null if not shown>,
  "status_text": "<status code and meaning as written>", "bore_mm": <int|null>, "stroke_mm": <int|null>,
  "pressure_bar": <int|null>, "mounting": "<or null>", "certification": "<certificate as written; null if not shown>",
  "carton_size": <pieces per carton, int|null>,
  "allocation_mass": "<mass used to allocate shared setup cost, as written, or null>", "allocation_mass_unit": "mg|g|kg|t",
  "surcharge_mass": "<mass the metal surcharge is charged on, as written, or null>", "surcharge_mass_unit": "mg|g|kg|t",
  "metal_index_code": "<price index code or null>", "number_format": "de-DE|en-US",
  "free_stock": <total freely available stock in pieces across storage locations; prefer a stated total; int|null>,
  "stock_lead_weeks": <delivery time from stock in weeks, int|null>,
  "production_lead_weeks": <production lead time in weeks, int|null>}]}""",
    "price_conditions": """Price conditions (condition records with validity and quantity scales) of ONE material.
{"material_number": "<number>", "conditions": [{"valid_from": "<date>", "valid_to": "<date>", "currency": "<ISO code>",
  "fx_key": "<key of the FX fixing it names, or null>", "price_unit_pieces": <the number of pieces the prices are quoted for, int>,
  "number_format": "de-DE|en-US", "scales": [{"min_quantity": "<from quantity as written>", "price": "<price as written>"}]}]}""",
    "mail": """Messages of the sales mailbox. One entry per message whose text is shown.
{"mailbox_address": "<the mailbox the user is logged in to, if the page shows it, else null>",
 "messages": [{"sender": "<sender address>", "timestamp": "<sent/received>", "subject": "<subject>",
  "tender_reference": "<the reference this message is about, exactly as written, with any suffix>",
  "topic": "discount_approval|condition_rules|price_indices|tech_release|packaging_tariffs|delivery_release|fx_fixing|setup_pools|project_bonus|other",
  "number_format": "de-DE|en-US",
  "discount": {"approves": <true only if the message itself grants a discount>, "percent": "<as written>",
               "min_order_value": "<minimum net order value the approval is conditional on, or null>"},
  "condition_rules": [{"group": "<key>", "discount_applies_to": "base_only|base_and_surcharge|none"}],
  "price_indices": [{"code": "<index code>", "rate": "<as written>", "unit": "<e.g. EUR/kg>", "valid_from": "<date or null>", "valid_to": "<date or null>"}],
  "tech_release": [{"reserve_key": "<key or null>", "revision": "<specification revision it is for>", "reserve_mm_per_end": <int>}],
  "packaging_tariffs": [{"key": "<tariff key>", "eur_per_carton": "<as written>"}],
  "delivery_release": [{"key": "<commitment key>", "material_number": "<material it is for>", "weeks": <int>, "max_quantity": <inclusive quantity ceiling, int|null>}],
  "fx_fixing": [{"key": "<FX key>", "currency": "<foreign currency>", "eur_per_unit": "<EUR for one unit of that currency, as written>"}],
  "setup_pools": [{"key": "<pool key>", "fee": "<the pool's one fee, as written>",
                   "cent_allocation": "largest_remainder|remainder_to_first|remainder_to_last|remainder_to_largest"}],
  "project_bonus": [{"key": "<plan key>", "bands": [{"from": "<lower bound>", "to": "<upper bound or null if open-ended>", "percent": "<rate>"}]}]}]}
Fill only the blocks the message's original text really contains; leave the others out. Take values from the
message as sent, never from a draft, preview or quoted template shown around it. One price index code can list
several rates with validity windows: give each as its own entry.""",
}

CONTEXT_SHAPE = """From the task brief, as JSON:
{"tender_reference": "<the tender's reference>", "scenario_date": "<ISO timestamp>", "company_name": "<the bidder's company name>",
 "vat_id": "<the bidder's VAT id or null>",
 "authorized_senders": {"discount_approval": "<mailbox local part the brief authorizes for discount approvals>",
   "condition_rules": "...", "price_indices": "...", "tech_release": "...", "packaging_tariffs": "...",
   "delivery_release": "...", "fx_fixing": "...", "setup_pools": "...", "project_bonus": "..."}}
The local part is what stands before the @; null for a topic the brief names no sender for."""


def _int(value) -> int | None:
    number = parse_number(value)
    return int(number) if number is not None else None


def _text(value) -> str | None:
    text = str(value).strip() if value is not None else ""
    return text if text and text.lower() not in ("null", "none", "n/a", "-", "—") else None


def _merge(store: dict, key, record: dict) -> None:
    old = store.setdefault(key, {})
    for name, value in record.items():
        if value is not None and value != "" and value != []:
            old[name] = value


class CaseFile:
    def __init__(self, brief: str, context: dict):
        self.brief = brief
        self.reference = _text(context.get("tender_reference")) or ""
        self.scenario = parse_when(context.get("scenario_date")) or datetime.now(timezone.utc)
        self.company = _text(context.get("company_name")) or ""
        self.vat_id = _text(context.get("vat_id")) or ""
        senders = context.get("authorized_senders") or {}
        self.senders = {topic: (_text(senders.get(topic)) or "").split("@")[0].lower() for topic in TOPICS}
        self.mailbox: str | None = None
        self.positions: dict[str, dict] = {}
        self.clarifications: dict[str, dict] = {}
        self.revisions: dict[str, dict] = {}
        self.requirements: dict[tuple[str, str], dict] = {}
        self.materials: dict[str, dict] = {}
        self.conditions: dict[str, dict[tuple, dict]] = {}
        self.messages: dict[tuple, dict] = {}
        self.answers: dict[str, tuple[str, str]] = {}  # question id -> (complete | absent, note)
        self.filed: set[str] = set()
        self.news: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
        self.pending = 0
        self.version = 0
        self._changed = asyncio.Event()

    # ---- filing evidence -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _bump(self) -> None:
        self.version += 1
        self._changed.set()

    async def wait_change(self, seen: int, timeout: float) -> bool:
        """True once the case file has moved past version `seen`."""
        loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
        end = loop.time() + timeout
        while self.version == seen:
            self._changed.clear()
            left = end - loop.time()
            if left <= 0:
                return False
            try:
                await asyncio.wait_for(self._changed.wait(), timeout=left)
            except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                return False
        return True

    def take_news(self, agent: str) -> list[str]:
        return self.news.pop(agent, [])

    def file(self, kind: str, text: str, source: str, agent: str) -> str:
        """File a document an agent chose; the extraction runs in the background and reports back as news."""
        if kind not in SHAPES:
            return f'unknown kind "{kind}"; the kinds are: {", ".join(SHAPES)}'
        if len(text.strip()) < 20:
            return "there is no document to file"
        digest = hashlib.sha1((kind + "\n" + text).encode("utf-8", "replace")).hexdigest()
        if digest in self.filed:
            return f"this document is already filed as {kind}"
        self.filed.add(digest)
        self.pending += 1
        asyncio.ensure_future(self._extract(kind, text, source, agent))
        return f"filed {len(text)} characters from {source} as {kind}; the facts in it will be reported to you"

    async def _extract(self, kind: str, text: str, source: str, agent: str) -> None:
        try:
            prompt = (f"TASK BRIEF\n{self.brief}\n\nThe tender reference is {self.reference}; the scenario date is "
                      f"{self.scenario.isoformat()}.\n\nKIND OF RECORD: {kind}\nSHAPE\n{SHAPES[kind]}\n\n"
                      f"EVIDENCE (from {source})\n{text[:60000]}")
            data = await llm.chat_json([{"role": "system", "content": EXTRACT_SYSTEM}, {"role": "user", "content": prompt}],
                                       think=True, max_tokens=8000, label=f"extract:{kind}")
            summary = self.merge(kind, data) if data else "the extraction failed; file the document again"
        except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
            summary = f"the extraction failed ({str(error)[:120]}); file the document again"
        self.news.setdefault(agent, []).append(f"From the {kind} document you filed ({source}): {summary}")
        self.pending -= 1
        self._bump()

    def merge(self, kind: str, data: dict) -> str:
        """Merge extracted records; returns a one-line account of what they said."""
        told: list[str] = []
        if kind == "positions":
            for row in data.get("positions") or []:
                key = _text(row.get("position"))
                if key:
                    _merge(self.positions, key, row)
                    told.append(f"{key}: {row.get('quantity')} {row.get('unit') or ''} -> {row.get('requirement_ref')}")
        elif kind == "clarifications":
            for row in data.get("answers") or []:
                key = _text(row.get("number"))
                if key:
                    self.clarifications[key] = row
                    told.append(f"answer {key} ({row.get('timestamp')})")
        elif kind == "revisions":
            for row in data.get("revisions") or []:
                key = _text(row.get("revision"))
                if key:
                    _merge(self.revisions, key, row)
                    told.append(f"{key}: {row.get('status')} ({row.get('date')})")
        elif kind == "requirements":
            revision = _text(data.get("revision")) or ""
            for row in data.get("requirements") or []:
                key = _text(row.get("requirement_ref"))
                if key:
                    _merge(self.requirements, (revision, key), row)
                    told.append(f"{key} in revision {revision or '?'}: bore {row.get('bore_mm')}, stroke {row.get('stroke_mm')}"
                                f"{' (usable travel)' if row.get('stroke_is_usable_travel') else ''}, {row.get('pressure_bar')} bar, "
                                f"{row.get('mounting')}, certification {row.get('certification')}, group {row.get('catalogue_group')}")
        elif kind == "material":
            for row in data.get("materials") or []:
                key = _text(row.get("material_number"))
                if key:
                    _merge(self.materials, key, row)
                    told.append(f"{key}: " + ", ".join(f"{name}={value}" for name, value in row.items()
                                                       if value is not None and name not in ("material_number", "description", "number_format")))
        elif kind == "price_conditions":
            key = _text(data.get("material_number"))
            for row in data.get("conditions") or []:
                if key and row.get("scales"):
                    self.conditions.setdefault(key, {})[(str(row.get("valid_from")), str(row.get("valid_to")))] = row
                    told.append(f"{key}: {row.get('valid_from')}..{row.get('valid_to')} {row.get('currency')} "
                                f"per {row.get('price_unit_pieces')} pcs, {len(row['scales'])} scales")
        elif kind == "mail":
            if _text(data.get("mailbox_address")) and "@" in data["mailbox_address"]:
                self.mailbox = data["mailbox_address"].strip()
            for row in data.get("messages") or []:
                key = (str(row.get("sender")), str(row.get("timestamp")), str(row.get("subject")))
                self.messages[key] = row
                blocks = [topic for topic in ("discount",) + TOPICS if row.get(topic)]
                told.append(f"{row.get('subject')} from {row.get('sender')} at {row.get('timestamp')} about "
                            f"{row.get('tender_reference')}: {row.get('topic')} ({', '.join(blocks) or 'no usable data'})")
        self._bump()
        return "; ".join(told)[:1500] if told else "nothing usable was found in it"

    # ---- from records to calculator inputs -------------------------------------------------------------------

    def governing_revision(self) -> str | None:
        current = []
        for key, row in self.revisions.items():
            when = parse_when(row.get("date"))
            if row.get("status") == "current" and (when is None or when <= self.scenario):
                current.append((when or datetime.min.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc), key))
        return max(current)[1] if current else None

    def _authorized(self, row: dict, topic: str) -> bool:
        """The brief's test for a record: exact tender reference, authorized sender, not after the scenario date."""
        sender = (_text(row.get("sender")) or "").lower()
        local, _, domain = sender.partition("@")
        if self.senders.get(topic) and local != self.senders[topic]:
            return False
        if self.mailbox and domain and domain != self.mailbox.lower().partition("@")[2]:
            return False
        if (_text(row.get("tender_reference")) or "").upper() != self.reference.upper():
            return False
        when = parse_when(row.get("timestamp"))
        return when is None or when <= self.scenario

    def authorities(self) -> Authorities:
        result = Authorities()
        floor = datetime.min.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
        ordered = sorted(self.messages.values(), key=lambda row: parse_when(row.get("timestamp")) or floor)
        day = self.scenario.date()
        for row in ordered:  # oldest first: a newer record replaces the older one, key by key
            fmt = row.get("number_format")
            discount = row.get("discount") or {}
            if discount.get("approves") and self._authorized(row, "discount_approval"):
                percent = parse_number(discount.get("percent"), fmt)
                if percent is not None:
                    result.discount_percent = percent
                    result.discount_min_order = parse_number(discount.get("min_order_value"), fmt)
            if row.get("condition_rules") and self._authorized(row, "condition_rules"):
                for rule in row["condition_rules"]:
                    if _text(rule.get("group")) and rule.get("discount_applies_to") in ("base_only", "base_and_surcharge", "none"):
                        result.clauses[rule["group"].strip()] = rule["discount_applies_to"]
            if row.get("price_indices") and self._authorized(row, "price_indices"):
                by_code: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}
                for entry in row["price_indices"]:
                    if _text(entry.get("code")):
                        by_code.setdefault(entry["code"].strip(), []).append(entry)
                for code, entries in by_code.items():
                    result.index_rates.pop(code, None)  # the latest message decides this code alone
                    for entry in entries:
                        start, end = parse_when(entry.get("valid_from")), parse_when(entry.get("valid_to"), end_of_day=True)
                        if (start and start.date() > day) or (end and end.date() < day):
                            continue
                        rate = parse_number(entry.get("rate"), fmt)
                        unit = re.search(r"/\s*(mg|g|kg|t)\b", str(entry.get("unit") or "EUR/kg"))
                        if rate is not None:
                            result.index_rates[code] = rate / MASS_TO_GRAMS[unit.group(1) if unit else "kg"]
                            break
            if row.get("tech_release") and self._authorized(row, "tech_release"):
                for entry in row["tech_release"]:
                    reserve = _int(entry.get("reserve_mm_per_end"))
                    if reserve is not None:
                        key = _text(entry.get("reserve_key")) or f"revision {entry.get('revision')}"
                        result.reserves[key] = (_text(entry.get("revision")), reserve)
            if row.get("packaging_tariffs") and self._authorized(row, "packaging_tariffs"):
                for entry in row["packaging_tariffs"]:
                    rate = parse_number(entry.get("eur_per_carton"), fmt)
                    if _text(entry.get("key")) and rate is not None:
                        result.tariffs[entry["key"].strip()] = rate
            if row.get("delivery_release") and self._authorized(row, "delivery_release"):
                for entry in row["delivery_release"]:
                    weeks = _int(entry.get("weeks"))
                    if _text(entry.get("key")) and weeks is not None:
                        result.commitments[entry["key"].strip()] = Commitment(
                            _text(entry.get("material_number")) or "", weeks, _int(entry.get("max_quantity")))
            if row.get("fx_fixing") and self._authorized(row, "fx_fixing"):
                for entry in row["fx_fixing"]:
                    rate = parse_number(entry.get("eur_per_unit"), fmt)
                    if _text(entry.get("key")) and rate is not None:
                        result.fx[entry["key"].strip()] = rate
            if row.get("setup_pools") and self._authorized(row, "setup_pools"):
                for entry in row["setup_pools"]:
                    fee = parse_number(entry.get("fee"), fmt)
                    if _text(entry.get("key")) and fee is not None:
                        result.pools[entry["key"].strip()] = (fee, entry.get("cent_allocation") or "largest_remainder")
            if row.get("project_bonus") and self._authorized(row, "project_bonus"):
                for entry in row["project_bonus"]:
                    bands = []
                    for band in entry.get("bands") or []:
                        lower, percent = parse_number(band.get("from"), fmt), parse_number(band.get("percent"), fmt)
                        if percent is not None:
                            bands.append(BonusBand(lower or Decimal(0), parse_number(band.get("to"), fmt), percent))
                    if _text(entry.get("key")) and bands:
                        result.bonus[entry["key"].strip()] = bands
        return result

    def inputs(self) -> SimpleNamespace:
        governing = self.governing_revision()
        positions = [Position(key, _text(row.get("requirement_ref")) or "", _int(row.get("quantity")) or 0,
                              bool(row.get("unit_is_set")), _text(row.get("description")) or "")
                     for key, row in sorted(self.positions.items())]
        clarifications = []
        for key, row in self.clarifications.items():
            entry = Clarification(key, parse_when(row.get("timestamp")),
                                  withdraws=[str(n).strip() for n in row.get("withdraws") or [] if _text(n)])
            for change in row.get("quantity_changes") or []:
                quantity = _int(change.get("quantity"))
                if _text(change.get("position")) and quantity is not None:
                    entry.quantity_changes.append((change["position"].strip(), quantity, change.get("unit_is_set")))
            for change in row.get("tech_amendments") or []:
                if _text(change.get("requirement_ref")) and _text(change.get("attribute")) and change.get("value") is not None:
                    entry.amendments.append((_text(change.get("revision")) or "", change["requirement_ref"].strip(),
                                             change["attribute"].strip(), str(change["value"])))
            for assigned in row.get("assignments") or []:
                position = _text(assigned.get("position"))
                if not position:
                    continue
                keys = {kind: _text(assigned.get(kind)) for kind in ASSIGNMENT_KINDS if _text(assigned.get(kind))}
                if keys:
                    entry.assignments.setdefault(position, {}).update(keys)
                fee = parse_number(assigned.get("ordinary_setup_fee"), assigned.get("number_format"))
                if fee is not None:
                    entry.setup_fees[position] = fee
            clarifications.append(entry)
        requirements = {}
        for (revision, ref), row in self.requirements.items():
            if governing and revision and not same_text(revision, governing):
                continue
            if not governing and revision:
                continue
            requirements[ref] = Requirement(
                ref, _int(row.get("bore_mm")), _int(row.get("stroke_mm")), _int(row.get("pressure_bar")),
                _text(row.get("mounting")), _text(row.get("certification")), _text(row.get("catalogue_group")),
                bool(row.get("stroke_is_usable_travel")), _text(row.get("reserve_key")), _int(row.get("pieces_per_set")))
        materials = []
        for number, row in self.materials.items():
            def grams(name):
                mass = parse_number(row.get(name), row.get("number_format"))
                return None if mass is None else mass * MASS_TO_GRAMS.get(str(row.get(name + "_unit") or "g").lower(), Decimal(1))
            conditions = []
            for record in (self.conditions.get(number) or {}).values():
                fmt = record.get("number_format")
                scales = [(int(parse_number(s.get("min_quantity"), fmt) or 0), parse_number(s.get("price"), fmt))
                          for s in record.get("scales") or [] if parse_number(s.get("price"), fmt) is not None]
                conditions.append(PriceCondition(parse_when(record.get("valid_from")), parse_when(record.get("valid_to"), end_of_day=True),
                                                 (_text(record.get("currency")) or "EUR").upper(), _text(record.get("fx_key")),
                                                 _int(record.get("price_unit_pieces")) or 1, scales))
            materials.append(Material(
                number, row.get("is_active"), _text(row.get("catalogue_group")), _int(row.get("bore_mm")),
                _int(row.get("stroke_mm")), _int(row.get("pressure_bar")), _text(row.get("mounting")),
                _text(row.get("certification")), _int(row.get("carton_size")), grams("allocation_mass"),
                grams("surcharge_mass"), _text(row.get("metal_index_code")), _int(row.get("free_stock")),
                _int(row.get("stock_lead_weeks")), _int(row.get("production_lead_weeks")), conditions))
        return SimpleNamespace(governing=governing, positions=positions, clarifications=clarifications,
                               requirements=requirements, materials=materials, authorities=self.authorities(),
                               no_material={qid.split(":", 1)[1] for qid, (status, _) in self.answers.items()
                                            if qid.startswith("material:") and status == "absent"})

    # ---- what is still unknown -------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def questions(self) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
        """The open questions, derived from the brief's rules and the facts on file: id and what to find."""
        facts = self.inputs()
        found: list[tuple[str, str]] = []

        def ask(qid: str, text: str) -> None:
            if qid not in self.answers:
                found.append((qid, text))

        if not facts.positions:
            ask("positions", "The tender's bill of quantities: every position with its number, quantity, unit and "
                             "requirement reference.")
        ask("clarifications", "Every answer in the tender's bidder Q&A, on all of its pages: quantity changes, "
                              "withdrawn answers, technical amendments and the keys an answer assigns to a position. "
                              "Answer this question complete once every page of the Q&A is filed.")
        if not self.mailbox:
            ask("mailbox", "The address of the sales mailbox (shown in the webmail).")
        if not facts.governing:
            ask("revision", "The revision history of the buyer's technical specification, to see which revision is "
                            "marked current.")
        refs = sorted({p.requirement_ref for p in facts.positions if p.requirement_ref})
        answers = active_clarifications(facts.clarifications, self.scenario)
        needs, waiting = resolve_requirements(facts.requirements, facts.governing, answers, facts.authorities)
        if facts.governing:
            lacking = [ref for ref in refs if ref not in needs or needs[ref].missing() or not needs[ref].catalogue_group]
            sets = {p.requirement_ref for p in facts.positions if p.is_set}
            lacking += [ref for ref in sets if ref in needs and not needs[ref].pieces_per_set and ref not in lacking]
            if lacking:
                ask("requirements", f"In specification revision {facts.governing} (the current one), the requirements "
                                    f"{', '.join(lacking)} in full: bore, stroke (nominal or usable travel, with its reserve key), "
                                    "pressure, mounting, certification, catalogue group, pieces per set.")
        for ref, key in waiting.items():
            ask(f"reserve:{ref}", f"The technical release for specification revision {facts.governing} that gives the "
                                  f"per-end reserve ({key}): requirement {ref} states a usable travel.")
        assigned, _ = merged_assignments(answers)
        quantities, _ = final_quantities(facts.positions, answers, needs)
        matched: dict[str, Material] = {}
        for ref in refs:
            need = needs.get(ref)
            if need is None or ref in waiting or need.missing():
                continue
            material = match_material(need, facts.materials)
            if material is None:
                seen = [f"{m.number} ({'active' if m.active else 'not active' if m.active is False else 'status unknown'}, "
                        f"{m.bore_mm}/{m.stroke_mm} mm, {m.pressure_bar} bar, {m.mounting}, {m.certification})"
                        for m in facts.materials if need.catalogue_group and same_text(m.catalogue_group, need.catalogue_group)]
                ask(f"material:{ref}", f"The ERP material for requirement {ref}: active, in catalogue group "
                                       f"{need.catalogue_group}, bore {need.bore_mm} mm, stroke {need.stroke_mm} mm, "
                                       f"{need.pressure_bar} bar, mounting {need.mounting}, certification "
                                       f"{need.certification or 'none'}. File each candidate's technical data and status. "
                                       f"On file for this group: {'; '.join(seen) or 'nothing yet'}. Answer absent only "
                                       "when every material of the group is on file and none matches.")
                continue
            matched[ref] = material
            gaps = [label for label, value in (("stock quantity", material.stock), ("lead time from stock", material.stock_lead_weeks),
                                               ("production lead time", material.production_lead_weeks),
                                               ("carton size", material.carton_size), ("allocation mass", material.allocation_mass_g),
                                               ("surcharge mass and metal index code", material.surcharge_mass_g)) if value is None]
            if not any(c.scales and c.valid_on(self.scenario) for c in material.conditions):
                gaps.append("the price condition valid on the scenario date with all its quantity scales")
            if gaps:
                ask(f"data:{material.number}", f"ERP material {material.number} (it matches requirement {ref}) still lacks: "
                                               f"{'; '.join(gaps)}.")
        if facts.authorities.discount_percent is None:
            ask("discount", f"The sales director's most recent discount approval for exactly {self.reference} (inbox and "
                            "archive). File the message; answer absent if no approval exists.")
        labels = {"condition_group": ("the condition rules message", facts.authorities.clauses),
                  "packaging_tariff": ("the packaging tariffs message", facts.authorities.tariffs),
                  "delivery_commitment": ("the delivery release message", facts.authorities.commitments),
                  "setup_pool": ("the setup pools message", facts.authorities.pools),
                  "project_bonus": ("the project bonus message", facts.authorities.bonus)}
        for position in sorted(assigned):
            for kind, key in assigned[position].items():
                label, known = labels[kind]
                if key not in known:
                    extra = ""
                    need = needs.get(next((p.requirement_ref for p in facts.positions if p.position == position), ""))
                    if kind == "delivery_commitment" and need is not None and need.ref in matched:
                        extra = f" (the position's material is {matched[need.ref].number})"
                    ask(f"{kind}:{key}", f"For {self.reference}: {label} that defines {key}, assigned to position {position}{extra}.")
        for material in matched.values():
            if material.index_code and material.index_code not in facts.authorities.index_rates:
                ask(f"index:{material.index_code}", f"For {self.reference}: the latest price index message with the rate of "
                                                    f"{material.index_code} (material {material.number}).")
            for condition in material.conditions:
                if condition.valid_on(self.scenario) and condition.currency != "EUR" and (condition.fx_key or "") not in facts.authorities.fx:
                    ask(f"fx:{condition.fx_key}", f"For {self.reference}: the FX fixing message with the rate of "
                                                  f"{condition.fx_key} ({condition.currency}, material {material.number}).")
        return found

    def answer(self, question: str, status: str, note: str) -> str:
        """An agent closes a question: its evidence is complete, or the thing does not exist."""
        open_ids = {qid for qid, _ in self.questions()}
        if question not in open_ids:
            return f'"{question}" is not an open question'
        if status not in ("complete", "absent"):
            return 'status must be "complete" or "absent"'
        if self.pending:
            return "facts from documents you filed are still being extracted; wait for them, then answer"
        if question.startswith("material:") and status == "absent":
            facts = self.inputs()

2. One agent per website explores it in its own browser. Each decides where to go, what to search for and which

   shared case file; the open questions derived from the brief's rules tell all agents what is still missing, so a
   fact found on one website (a catalogue group, a key) steers the search on another.

4. An agent enters the bid in the tender portal, has the mail agent fetch the signing TAN, and submits.

import json
import os
import sys
import time

import llm
import run as contract

engineering team. Each agent works a different website at the same time; you work the website "{site}" at {url}
in your own browser tab. Together you must find every fact the bid rules need. You only find and file evidence:
you never calculate prices.

{brief}
END OF BRIEF

{actions}
Case-file actions:
  {{"do": "keep", "kind": "<kind>", "note": "<what it is>"}}
      File the document in front of you (the current page, or the document you just collected or fetched) as
      evidence. Its facts are then extracted into the shared case file and reported back to you. Kinds:
        positions         the tender's bill of quantities
        clarifications    answers of the tender's bidder Q&A
        revisions         the revision history of the buyer's technical specification
        requirements      the requirement details of one specification revision
        material          ERP master data of materials: technical attributes, status, planning, stock
        price_conditions  ERP price conditions of one material: validity, currency, quantity scales
        mail              an opened mail message
  {{"do": "answer", "question": "<id>", "status": "complete" | "absent", "note": "..."}}
      Close an open question: "complete" when all its evidence is filed (needed for lists that only you know to be
      complete), "absent" when you searched properly and what is asked for does not exist.

How to work
- Every turn starts with the case file and the OPEN QUESTIONS. Work on the questions your website can answer;
  the other agents handle the rest. Facts they file show up in the case file and can open new questions for you.
- You remember only the page in front of you: file a relevant page with keep BEFORE you leave it. keep files the
  whole document, also what was cut from your view. File a document once, with the right kind.
- File pages that state the facts themselves (an opened document, record or message), not menus or hit lists.
  For a paged list or document that matters, use collect so that no page is missed, then keep it.
- The websites hold traps: superseded revisions, look-alike records for other tender references, drafts and
  previews, blocked materials, future-dated records, values in the wrong unit or number format. Check dates,
  references, senders and status marks before you rely on a record, and follow the brief's rules on which one
  counts. When in doubt, file both and let the facts decide.

class Team:

    agent is idle and no filed document is still being read."""

    def __init__(self, case: CaseFile, names: list[str], deadline: float):
        self.case, self.names, self.deadline = case, set(names), deadline
        self.idle: set[str] = set()

    def hook(self, name: str):
        async def hold(why: str) -> str | None:
            version = self.case.version
            if why == "wait":
                await self.case.wait_change(version, 12)
                return "the case file changed" if self.case.version != version else "nothing new yet"
            before = {qid for qid, _ in self.case.questions()}

    system = INVESTIGATOR.format(site=name, url=tab.base_url, brief=case.brief, actions=ACTIONS_HELP)

    count = max(1, len(browsers.cdp_urls()) or min(len(sites), 4))
    opened, tabs, pages = [], {}, []
    for number in range(min(count, len(sites))):
        browser, page = await browsers.connect(playwright, number)
        opened.append(browser)
        pages.append(page)
    for index, site in enumerate(sites):
        page = pages[index] if index < len(pages) else await pages[-1].context.new_page()
        tabs[site["siteId"]] = Tab(page, site)
    return opened, tabs


async def solve(task: dict, playwright) -> dict | None:
    started = time.time()
    sites = [site for site in task.get("access") or [] if isinstance(site, dict) and site.get("siteId") and site.get("url")]
    only = {name for name in os.environ.get("AGENT_SITES", "").split(",") if name}
    if not sites or not task.get("brief"):
        return None
    brief = task["brief"]

    case = CaseFile(brief, context)
    print(f"Context: tender {case.reference}, scenario {case.scenario.isoformat()}, company {case.company}, "
          f"senders {case.senders}", flush=True)

    left = contract.seconds_left(task)
    budget = min(left, 20 * 60) if left != float("inf") else 20 * 60  # a scored run has 20 minutes
    hard_stop = started + budget - 45
    submit_reserve = min(330, budget * 0.3)
    investigate_until = hard_stop - submit_reserve

    opened, tabs = await open_tabs(playwright, sites)
    try:
        working = [tab for name, tab in tabs.items() if not only or name in only]
        team = Team(case, [tab.site_id for tab in working], investigate_until)
        outcomes = await asyncio.gather(*(investigator(case, team, tab, investigate_until).run() for tab in working),
                                        return_exceptions=True)
        for tab, outcome in zip(working, outcomes):
            print(f"[{tab.site_id}] finished: {outcome if isinstance(outcome, Exception) else json.dumps(outcome, ensure_ascii=False)[:300]}", flush=True)
        for _ in range(40):  # facts of the last filed documents
            if not case.pending:
                break
            await asyncio.sleep(0.5)

        facts = case.inputs()
        bid = calculate_bid(case.reference, case.scenario, facts.governing, facts.positions, facts.clarifications,
                            facts.requirements, facts.materials, facts.authorities, facts.no_material)
        print(f"Investigation took {time.time() - started:.0f} s. {llm.summary()}", flush=True)
        print("CASE FILE\n" + case.status(), flush=True)
        print("OPEN QUESTIONS LEFT: " + (", ".join(qid for qid, _ in case.questions()) or "none"), flush=True)
        print("BID: " + json.dumps(bid.answer(), ensure_ascii=False) + f" omitted={bid.omitted} notes={bid.notes}", flush=True)
        if os.environ.get("AGENT_DUMP"):
            with open(os.environ["AGENT_DUMP"], "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
                handle.write(case.dump())
        if os.environ.get("AGENT_SKIP_SUBMIT") == "1":
            return bid.answer()

        submission = task.get("submission") or {}
        tender_tab = tabs.get(submission.get("siteId")) or next(
            (tab for tab in tabs.values() if submission.get("url", "").startswith(tab.base_url)), None)
        mail_tab = tabs.get(str(context.get("mail_site") or ""))
        if submission.get("kind") == "site" and tender_tab is not None:
            import submit
            receipt = await submit.submit_bid(
                tender_tab, mail_tab, bid,
                {"tender_reference": case.reference, "scenario_date": case.scenario.isoformat(), "company": case.company,
                 "vat_id": case.vat_id, "email": case.mailbox or ""}, brief, hard_stop)
            print(f"Submission: {json.dumps(receipt, ensure_ascii=False)[:600]}. Total {time.time() - started:.0f} s. {llm.summary()}", flush=True)
        return bid.answer()
    finally:
        for browser in opened:
            try:
                await browser.close()
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                pass


async def main() -> int:
    task, token = contract.load_run()
    print(f"Run {task.get('run_id')}: {len(task.get('access') or [])} site(s), {contract.seconds_left(task):.0f}s left.", flush=True)
    async with async_playwright() as playwright:
        answer = await solve(task, playwright)
    if not answer:
        print("No answer to submit; exiting cleanly.")
    elif (task.get("submission") or {}).get("kind") == "site":
        print(f"Answer worked out for the site: {json.dumps(answer)}")
    elif not token:
        print(f"Answer (local run, not submitted): {json.dumps(answer)}")
    else:
        status, body = contract.submit_answer(task, token, answer)
        print(f"Submitted answer -> HTTP {status}: {body}")
        return 0 if status < 300 else 1
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(asyncio.run(main()))

    finally:
        for browser in opened:
            try:
                await browser.close()

    task, token = contract.load_run()
    print(f"Run {task.get('run_id')}: {len(task.get('access') or [])} site(s), {contract.seconds_left(task):.0f}s left.", flush=True)

"""RFQ-to-bid: a team of model-directed agents, one per website, and a deterministic calculator.

1. The model reads the brief: which tender, which date, which senders the rules authorize.
2. One agent per website explores it in its own browser. Each decides where to go, what to search for and which
   pages are evidence, and files those pages. A model call turns every filed page into structured facts in the
   shared case file; the open questions derived from the brief's rules tell all agents what is still missing, so a
   fact found on one website (a catalogue group, a key) steers the search on another.
3. `calculator.py` applies the bid rules to the facts: arithmetic only.
4. An agent enters the bid in the tender portal, has the mail agent fetch the signing TAN, and submits.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import json
import os
import sys
import time

from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

import browsers
import llm
import run as contract
from browser_env import Tab
from calculator import calculate_bid
from casefile import SHAPES, CaseFile, read_context
from worker import ACTIONS_HELP, Agent

INVESTIGATOR = """You are one of several research agents preparing a tender bid for a manufacturer's sales
engineering team. Each agent works a different website at the same time; you work the website "{site}" at {url}
in your own browser tab. Together you must find every fact the bid rules need. You only find and file evidence:
you never calculate prices.

TASK BRIEF (the rules are authoritative)
{brief}
END OF BRIEF

{actions}
Case-file actions:
  {{"do": "keep", "kind": "<kind>", "note": "<what it is>"}}
      File the document in front of you (the current page, or the document you just collected or fetched) as
      evidence. Its facts are then extracted into the shared case file and reported back to you. Kinds:
        positions         the tender's bill of quantities
        clarifications    answers of the tender's bidder Q&A
        revisions         the revision history of the buyer's technical specification
        requirements      the requirement details of one specification revision
        material          ERP master data of materials: technical attributes, status, planning, stock
        price_conditions  ERP price conditions of one material: validity, currency, quantity scales
        mail              an opened mail message
  {{"do": "answer", "question": "<id>", "status": "complete" | "absent", "note": "..."}}
      Close an open question: "complete" when all its evidence is filed (needed for lists that only you know to be
      complete), "absent" when you searched properly and what is asked for does not exist.

How to work
- Every turn starts with the case file and the OPEN QUESTIONS. Work on the questions your website can answer;
  the other agents handle the rest. Facts they file show up in the case file and can open new questions for you.
- You remember only the page in front of you: file a relevant page with keep BEFORE you leave it. keep files the
  whole document, also what was cut from your view. File a document once, with the right kind.
- File pages that state the facts themselves (an opened document, record or message), not menus or hit lists.
  For a paged list or document that matters, use collect so that no page is missed, then keep it.
- The websites hold traps: superseded revisions, look-alike records for other tender references, drafts and
  previews, blocked materials, future-dated records, values in the wrong unit or number format. Check dates,
  references, senders and status marks before you rely on a record, and follow the brief's rules on which one
  counts. When in doubt, file both and let the facts decide.
- Follow the search hints a website gives. If a search returns nothing or too much, change the search terms.
- When no open question is left for your website, finish with done. You are called again if new questions arise.
"""


class Team:
    """Holds an agent that has nothing to do until the case file brings news, and ends the investigation when every
    agent is idle and no filed document is still being read."""

    def __init__(self, case: CaseFile, names: list[str], deadline: float):
        self.case, self.names, self.deadline = case, set(names), deadline
        self.idle: set[str] = set()
        self.finished = asyncio.Event()

    def hook(self, name: str):
        async def hold(why: str) -> str | None:
            version = self.case.version
            if why == "wait":
                await self.case.wait_change(version, 12)
                return "the case file changed" if self.case.version != version else "nothing new yet"
            before = {qid for qid, _ in self.case.questions()}
            self.idle.add(name)
            try:
                while not self.finished.is_set() and time.time() < self.deadline:
                    changed = await self.case.wait_change(version, 1.0)
                    if self.finished.is_set():
                        break
                    if changed:
                        version = self.case.version
                        fresh = {qid for qid, _ in self.case.questions()} - before
                        if fresh or self.case.news.get(name):
                            return "The case file has news" + (f"; new open questions: {', '.join(sorted(fresh))}" if fresh else "") + "."
                    elif self.idle == self.names and self.case.pending == 0:
                        self.finished.set()
                return None
            finally:
                self.idle.discard(name)
        return hold


def investigator(case: CaseFile, team: Team, tab: Tab, deadline: float) -> Agent:
    name = tab.site_id
    system = INVESTIGATOR.format(site=name, url=tab.base_url, brief=case.brief, actions=ACTIONS_HELP)

    def briefing() -> str:
        questions = case.questions()
        news = case.take_news(name)
        text = f"CASE FILE\n{case.status()}\n\nOPEN QUESTIONS\n"
        text += "\n".join(f"- [{qid}] {question}" for qid, question in questions) or "(none)"
        if news:
            text += "\n\nNEWS FROM YOUR FILED DOCUMENTS\n" + "\n".join(f"- {item}" for item in news)
        if case.pending:
            text += f"\n\n({case.pending} filed document(s) are still being read.)"
        return text

    agent: Agent

    async def keep(action: dict) -> str:
        document, source = agent.document()
        return case.file(str(action.get("kind", "")), document, source, name)

    async def answer(action: dict) -> str:
        return case.answer(str(action.get("question", "")).strip("[] "), str(action.get("status", "")), str(action.get("note", "")))

    agent = Agent(name, tab, system, briefing, extra={"keep": keep, "answer": answer}, deadline=deadline,
                  max_steps=int(os.environ.get("AGENT_MAX_STEPS", "150")), idle=team.hook(name))
    return agent


async def open_tabs(playwright, sites: list[dict]) -> tuple[list, dict[str, Tab]]:
    """One tab per website: a browser each while the run has enough of them, else further tabs in the last one."""
    count = max(1, len(browsers.cdp_urls()) or min(len(sites), 4))
    opened, tabs, pages = [], {}, []
    for number in range(min(count, len(sites))):
        browser, page = await browsers.connect(playwright, number)
        opened.append(browser)
        pages.append(page)
    for index, site in enumerate(sites):
        page = pages[index] if index < len(pages) else await pages[-1].context.new_page()
        tabs[site["siteId"]] = Tab(page, site)
    return opened, tabs


async def solve(task: dict, playwright) -> dict | None:
    started = time.time()
    sites = [site for site in task.get("access") or [] if isinstance(site, dict) and site.get("siteId") and site.get("url")]
    only = {name for name in os.environ.get("AGENT_SITES", "").split(",") if name}
    if not sites or not task.get("brief"):
        return None
    brief = task["brief"]
    listing = "\n".join(f"- {site['siteId']}: {site['url']}" for site in sites)
    context = await read_context(brief + f"\n\nThe websites of this run:\n{listing}")
    case = CaseFile(brief, context)
    print(f"Context: tender {case.reference}, scenario {case.scenario.isoformat()}, company {case.company}, "
          f"senders {case.senders}", flush=True)

    left = contract.seconds_left(task)
    budget = min(left, 20 * 60) if left != float("inf") else 20 * 60  # a scored run has 20 minutes
    hard_stop = started + budget - 45
    submit_reserve = min(330, budget * 0.3)
    investigate_until = hard_stop - submit_reserve

    opened, tabs = await open_tabs(playwright, sites)
    try:
        working = [tab for name, tab in tabs.items() if not only or name in only]
        team = Team(case, [tab.site_id for tab in working], investigate_until)
        outcomes = await asyncio.gather(*(investigator(case, team, tab, investigate_until).run() for tab in working),
                                        return_exceptions=True)
        for tab, outcome in zip(working, outcomes):
            print(f"[{tab.site_id}] finished: {outcome if isinstance(outcome, Exception) else json.dumps(outcome, ensure_ascii=False)[:300]}", flush=True)
        for _ in range(40):  # facts of the last filed documents
            if not case.pending:
                break
            await asyncio.sleep(0.5)

        facts = case.inputs()
        bid = calculate_bid(case.reference, case.scenario, facts.governing, facts.positions, facts.clarifications,
                            facts.requirements, facts.materials, facts.authorities, facts.no_material)
        print(f"Investigation took {time.time() - started:.0f} s. {llm.summary()}", flush=True)
        print("CASE FILE\n" + case.status(), flush=True)
        print("OPEN QUESTIONS LEFT: " + (", ".join(qid for qid, _ in case.questions()) or "none"), flush=True)
        print("BID: " + json.dumps(bid.answer(), ensure_ascii=False) + f" omitted={bid.omitted} notes={bid.notes}", flush=True)
        if os.environ.get("AGENT_DUMP"):
            with open(os.environ["AGENT_DUMP"], "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
                handle.write(case.dump())
        if os.environ.get("AGENT_SKIP_SUBMIT") == "1":
            return bid.answer()

        submission = task.get("submission") or {}
        tender_tab = tabs.get(submission.get("siteId")) or next(
            (tab for tab in tabs.values() if submission.get("url", "").startswith(tab.base_url)), None)
        mail_tab = tabs.get(str(context.get("mail_site") or ""))
        if submission.get("kind") == "site" and tender_tab is not None:
            import submit
            receipt = await submit.submit_bid(
                tender_tab, mail_tab, bid,
                {"tender_reference": case.reference, "scenario_date": case.scenario.isoformat(), "company": case.company,
                 "vat_id": case.vat_id, "email": case.mailbox or ""}, brief, hard_stop)
            print(f"Submission: {json.dumps(receipt, ensure_ascii=False)[:600]}. Total {time.time() - started:.0f} s. {llm.summary()}", flush=True)
        return bid.answer()
    finally:
        for browser in opened:
            try:
                await browser.close()
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                pass


async def main() -> int:
    task, token = contract.load_run()
    print(f"Run {task.get('run_id')}: {len(task.get('access') or [])} site(s), {contract.seconds_left(task):.0f}s left.", flush=True)
    async with async_playwright() as playwright:
        answer = await solve(task, playwright)
    if not answer:
        print("No answer to submit; exiting cleanly.")
    elif (task.get("submission") or {}).get("kind") == "site":
        print(f"Answer worked out for the site: {json.dumps(answer)}")
    elif not token:
        print(f"Answer (local run, not submitted): {json.dumps(answer)}")
    else:
        status, body = contract.submit_answer(task, token, answer)
        print(f"Submitted answer -> HTTP {status}: {body}")
        return 0 if status < 300 else 1
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(asyncio.run(main()))

"""The agents' model client: one JSON chat call to the hosted Qwen, built to survive a busy run.

Every decision the agents take goes through `chat_json`: JSON mode, thinking on or off per call, a cap on how many
calls run at once (the hosted model serves 32 per team across all its runs), retries with backoff and a tolerant
parse of the reply. It never raises: when the last attempt fails it returns {} and the caller decides how to go on
without an answer. `STATS` adds up calls, tokens and seconds; `summary` is the line a run prints at its end.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import json
import os
import random
import re
import sys
import time

from openai import APIStatusError, AsyncOpenAI

MODEL = "qwen"
MAX_CONCURRENT = 16  # the team's limit is 32 across all its runs, and test runs may overlap
ATTEMPTS = 5
CALL_TIMEOUT = 150  # seconds: a model that scaled to zero is slow to answer its first call
MAX_TOKENS_CEILING = 16000  # a reply cut off by its token limit is asked again with twice the room, up to this
PERMANENT = (400, 401, 403, 404, 413, 422)  # asking again rarely helps: one more try, then give up
# The hosted Qwen's simulated prices in USD per million tokens, for the estimate in `summary`.
PRICE_INPUT, PRICE_CACHED, PRICE_OUTPUT = 0.15, 0.016, 0.47
REMINDER = "That reply was not a single JSON object. Answer again with exactly one JSON object and nothing else."

STATS = {"calls": 0, "failed": 0, "prompt_tokens": 0, "cached_tokens": 0, "completion_tokens": 0, "seconds": 0.0}

_bound: dict = {}  # the client and the gate belong to one event loop; another loop (tests) gets its own


def _session() -> tuple[AsyncOpenAI, asyncio.Semaphore]:
    loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
    if _bound.get("loop") is not loop:
        client = AsyncOpenAI(base_url=os.environ["QWEN_BASE_URL"], api_key=os.environ["QWEN_API_KEY"],
                             timeout=CALL_TIMEOUT, max_retries=0)  # the retries are ours, so that they are counted
        _bound.update(loop=loop, client=client, gate=asyncio.Semaphore(MAX_CONCURRENT))
    return _bound["client"], _bound["gate"]


def parse_json_object(text: str | None) -> dict | None:
    """The JSON object in a model's reply, or None: a thinking block, code fences and text around it are ignored."""
    text = re.sub(r"<think>.*?</think>", "", text or "", flags=re.DOTALL).strip()
    if not text:
        return None
    candidates = [text]
    fenced = re.search(r"```(?:json)?\s*(.*?)```", text, re.DOTALL)
    if fenced:
        candidates.append(fenced.group(1).strip())
    start, end = text.find("{"), text.rfind("}")
    if 0 <= start < end:
        candidates.append(text[start:end + 1])
    for candidate in candidates:
        try:
            parsed = json.loads(candidate, strict=False)  # models put raw line breaks into strings
        except ValueError:
            continue
        if isinstance(parsed, dict):
            return parsed
    if start >= 0:  # an object followed by text that has braces of its own
        try:
            parsed, _ = json.JSONDecoder(strict=False).raw_decode(text[start:])
        except ValueError:
            return None
        if isinstance(parsed, dict):
            return parsed
    return None


def _count(usage) -> None:
    if usage is None:
        return
    STATS["prompt_tokens"] += usage.prompt_tokens or 0
    STATS["completion_tokens"] += usage.completion_tokens or 0
    STATS["cached_tokens"] += getattr(usage.prompt_tokens_details, "cached_tokens", None) or 0


async def chat_json(messages: list[dict], *, think: bool = True, max_tokens: int = 6000, label: str = "") -> dict:
    """One chat call that answers with a JSON object. {} when every attempt failed; it never raises.

    `think` turns the model's reasoning on or off: off is about twice as fast, for the easy steps. `label` names the
    caller in the failure lines on stderr.
    """
    try:
        client, gate = _session()
    except KeyError as missing:
        STATS["failed"] += 1
        print(f"[llm] {label or 'call'}: {missing} is not set, no model to ask", file=sys.stderr)
        return {}
    conversation = messages
    for attempt in range(1, ATTEMPTS + 1):
        permanent = False
        try:
            async with gate:
                STATS["calls"] += 1
                started = time.monotonic()
                try:
                    reply = await asyncio.wait_for(client.chat.completions.create(
                        model=MODEL, messages=conversation, temperature=0, max_tokens=max_tokens,
                        response_format={"type": "json_object"},
                        extra_body={"chat_template_kwargs": {"enable_thinking": think}}), CALL_TIMEOUT)
                finally:
                    STATS["seconds"] += time.monotonic() - started
            _count(reply.usage)
            choice = reply.choices[0]
            content = choice.message.content or ""
            parsed = parse_json_object(content)
            if parsed is not None:
                return parsed
            if choice.finish_reason == "length":
                problem = f"the reply was cut off at {max_tokens} tokens"
                max_tokens = min(max_tokens * 2, MAX_TOKENS_CEILING)
            else:
                problem = f"the reply is not a JSON object: {content[:120]!r}"
                conversation = [*messages, {"role": "assistant", "content": content[:2000]},
                                {"role": "user", "content": REMINDER}]
        except asyncio.TimeoutError:
            problem = f"no reply within {CALL_TIMEOUT} s"
        except APIStatusError as error:
            problem = f"HTTP {error.status_code}: {str(error)[:200]}"
            permanent = error.status_code in PERMANENT
        except Exception as error:  # the connection, the proxy, a reply without choices
            problem = f"{type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:200]}"
        STATS["failed"] += 1
        last = attempt == ATTEMPTS or (permanent and attempt >= 2)
        print(f"[llm] {label or 'call'}: attempt {attempt} failed, {problem}" + ("; giving up" if last else ""),
              file=sys.stderr)
        if last:
            break
        await asyncio.sleep(min(2 ** attempt, 20) * random.uniform(0.5, 1))
    return {}


def summary() -> str:
    """The run's model use in one line, with what it costs at the hosted model's simulated prices."""
    fresh = STATS["prompt_tokens"] - STATS["cached_tokens"]
    cost = (fresh * PRICE_INPUT + STATS["cached_tokens"] * PRICE_CACHED
            + STATS["completion_tokens"] * PRICE_OUTPUT) / 1_000_000
    return (f"LLM: {STATS['calls']} calls ({STATS['failed']} failed), {STATS['prompt_tokens']} prompt tokens "
            f"({STATS['cached_tokens']} cached), {STATS['completion_tokens']} completion tokens, "
            f"{STATS['seconds']:.0f} s in calls, about ${cost:.4f}")

# QuoteCraft — from RFQ to bid

A team of model-directed agents that reads a tender across four business websites it has never seen, works out the
bid the rules call for, and enters and signs it in the tender portal.

## How it works

```
task brief ──► model reads it: tender, scenario date, authorized senders
                    │
   ┌────────────────┼──────────────────┬─────────────────┐
   ▼                ▼                  ▼                 ▼
 agent            agent              agent             agent        one per website, each in its own browser:
 tender portal    supplier portal    ERP               webmail      the model picks every click, search and page
   │  keep          │  keep            │  keep           │  keep
   └────────────────┴───────┬──────────┴─────────────────┘
                            ▼
                     shared case file        a model call turns each filed page into typed facts;
                            │                the brief's rules yield the open questions all agents see
                            ▼
                      calculator.py          the bid rules as exact Decimal arithmetic
                            ▼
                     submission agent        fills the bid form it finds; the mail agent fetches the TAN
```

1. **Read the brief.** One model call extracts the tender reference, the scenario date, the bidder and which
   mailbox the rules authorize for which kind of record.
2. **Investigate in parallel.** One agent per website (`worker.Agent`). Each turn it sees its page as accessible
   text with numbered controls (`browser_env.Tab`), plus the case file and its open questions, and answers with
   actions: log in, click, fill, select, search, page through a list, download a file, or `keep` the page as
   evidence. Nothing in the code knows a URL, a selector or a click path of any website.
3. **File facts.** `keep` hands the page to a second model call that extracts typed records (positions, Q&A
   answers, revisions, requirements, materials, price conditions, mail records). `casefile.CaseFile` merges them
   and derives what is still unknown: a catalogue group found in the specification becomes an ERP question, a key
   in a Q&A answer becomes a mailbox question, and so on. Agents finish when their website has nothing left to add.
4. **Calculate.** `calculator.calculate_bid` applies the bid rules of the brief: latest clarification, withdrawn
   answers, scoped amendments, usable travel, sets to pieces, price scales, FX, conditional discount, condition
   clauses, shared stock, delivery commitments, cartons, pooled setup, project bonus, rounding. A position that
   lacks evidence is left out rather than guessed.
5. **Submit.** `submit.submit_bid` gives the bid to an agent on the tender portal, which fills whatever bid form
   it finds, asks a mail agent for the signing TAN and confirms the receipt.

## What is model and what is code

| The model decides | Code does |
| --- | --- |
| where to go, what to search for, which record or document matters | renders the page, carries out the chosen action |
| how to pass a popup, access check, login or error page | retries a server error, re-reads the page |
| which page is evidence and of what kind | pages through a list the model chose, reads a file it chose |
| what a page says (extraction into typed facts) | parses numbers and dates, checks sender, reference and date |
| when a search is complete or a record does not exist | arithmetic, rounding, allocation |
| how to fill and sign the bid form | — |

No scenario value (reference, material, price, key, login, TAN) appears anywhere in the package.

## Files

| File | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `agent.py` | Entry point: reads the run, starts the site agents, calculates, hands the bid to the submission agent |
| `worker.py` | The agent loop: page text in, the model's actions out |
| `browser_env.py` | A tab as accessible text (labels, descriptions, tooltips, frames, collapsed sections) and the actions on it |
| `casefile.py` | Evidence to typed facts, open questions, calculator inputs |
| `calculator.py` | The bid rules as Decimal arithmetic |
| `submit.py` | Bid entry and signing |
| `llm.py` | The hosted Qwen through the run's metering proxy: JSON replies, retries, a concurrency cap |
| `run.py`, `browsers.py`, `models.py` | The starter kit's plumbing: the run contract, the run's browsers, the hosted models |
| `agent.json` | Setup (`uv sync`), run command, four browsers, the hosted `qwen` |
| `tests/` | The calculator rule by rule, the page rendering against local fixtures, the plumbing against fakes |

## Running it

In the sandbox the platform sets everything (`CHALLENGE_API_URL`, `CHALLENGE_RUN_TOKEN`, `CDP_URLS`, `QWEN_*`):

```sh
atira test-run . --challenge rfq
```

On your machine, against the public websites with the scouting logins (nothing counts), with `atira models proxy`
running in another terminal:

```sh
python ../tools/local_run.py --no-submit
```

Switches: `AGENT_SKIP_SUBMIT=1` stops before the bid form, `AGENT_SITES=a,b` starts only those site agents,
`AGENT_MAX_STEPS` caps an agent's turns, `AGENT_DUMP=<file>` writes the case file as JSON.

```sh
uv run python -m unittest discover tests
```

   ┌────────────────┼──────────────────┬─────────────────┐
   ▼                ▼                  ▼                 ▼
 agent            agent              agent             agent        one per website, each in its own browser:
 tender portal    supplier portal    ERP               webmail      the model picks every click, search and page
   │  keep          │  keep            │  keep           │  keep
   └────────────────┴───────┬──────────┴─────────────────┘
                            ▼
                     shared case file        a model call turns each filed page into typed facts;
                            │                the brief's rules yield the open questions all agents see
                            ▼
                      calculator.py          the bid rules as exact Decimal arithmetic
                            ▼
                     submission agent        fills the bid form it finds; the mail agent fetches the TAN
```

1. **Read the brief.** One model call extracts the tender reference, the scenario date, the bidder and which
   mailbox the rules authorize for which kind of record.
2. **Investigate in parallel.** One agent per website (`worker.Agent`). Each turn it sees its page as accessible
   text with numbered controls (`browser_env.Tab`), plus the case file and its open questions, and answers with
   actions: log in, click, fill, select, search, page through a list, download a file, or `keep` the page as
   evidence. Nothing in the code knows a URL, a selector or a click path of any website.
3. **File facts.** `keep` hands the page to a second model call that extracts typed records (positions, Q&A
   answers, revisions, requirements, materials, price conditions, mail records). `casefile.CaseFile` merges them
   and derives what is still unknown: a catalogue group found in the specification becomes an ERP question, a key
   in a Q&A answer becomes a mailbox question, and so on. Agents finish when their website has nothing left to add.
4. **Calculate.** `calculator.calculate_bid` applies the bid rules of the brief: latest clarification, withdrawn
   answers, scoped amendments, usable travel, sets to pieces, price scales, FX, conditional discount, condition
   clauses, shared stock, delivery commitments, cartons, pooled setup, project bonus, rounding. A position that
   lacks evidence is left out rather than guessed.
5. **Submit.** `submit.submit_bid` gives the bid to an agent on the tender portal, which fills whatever bid form
   it finds, asks a mail agent for the signing TAN and confirms the receipt.

## What is model and what is code

| The model decides | Code does |
| --- | --- |
| where to go, what to search for, which record or document matters | renders the page, carries out the chosen action |
| how to pass a popup, access check, login or error page | retries a server error, re-reads the page |
| which page is evidence and of what kind | pages through a list the model chose, reads a file it chose |
| what a page says (extraction into typed facts) | parses numbers and dates, checks sender, reference and date |
| when a search is complete or a record does not exist | arithmetic, rounding, allocation |
| how to fill and sign the bid form | — |

No scenario value (reference, material, price, key, login, TAN) appears anywhere in the package.

## Files

| File | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `agent.py` | Entry point: reads the run, starts the site agents, calculates, hands the bid to the submission agent |
| `worker.py` | The agent loop: page text in, the model's actions out |
| `browser_env.py` | A tab as accessible text (labels, descriptions, tooltips, frames, collapsed sections) and the actions on it |
| `casefile.py` | Evidence to typed facts, open questions, calculator inputs |
| `calculator.py` | The bid rules as Decimal arithmetic |
| `submit.py` | Bid entry and signing |
| `llm.py` | The hosted Qwen through the run's metering proxy: JSON replies, retries, a concurrency cap |
| `run.py`, `browsers.py`, `models.py` | The starter kit's plumbing: the run contract, the run's browsers, the hosted models |
| `agent.json` | Setup (`uv sync`), run command, four browsers, the hosted `qwen` |
| `tests/` | The calculator rule by rule, the page rendering against local fixtures, the plumbing against fakes |

## Running it

In the sandbox the platform sets everything (`CHALLENGE_API_URL`, `CHALLENGE_RUN_TOKEN`, `CDP_URLS`, `QWEN_*`):

```sh
atira test-run . --challenge rfq
```

On your machine, against the public websites with the scouting logins (nothing counts), with `atira models proxy`
running in another terminal:

```sh
python ../tools/local_run.py --no-submit
```

Switches: `AGENT_SKIP_SUBMIT=1` stops before the bid form, `AGENT_SITES=a,b` starts only those site agents,
`AGENT_MAX_STEPS` caps an agent's turns, `AGENT_DUMP=<file>` writes the case file as JSON.

```sh
uv run python -m unittest discover tests
```

# Atira starter kit

A minimal starting point, not an agent. It does the platform plumbing: it reads the run, attaches to the run's
browsers and shows how to call the free hosted models. Then it stops at `solve()` in `agent.py`, the place for your
agent. Out of the box it exits without an answer.

| File | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `run.py` | The run contract: reads the run (`load_run`) and submits an API answer (`submit_answer`) |
| `browsers.py` | Attaches to the run's browsers over CDP and gets a page (`connect`); locally it starts a Chromium |
| `models.py` | One call to each hosted model: `ask_qwen` (Qwen3.8-Flash-Next) and `ask_clef` (Cloudflare Clef) |
| `agent.py` | The entry point: reads the run, connects browser 1, calls `solve(task, page)` and submits what it returns |
| `agent.json` | How the sandbox installs (`uv sync`, the versions in `uv.lock`) and runs it; it waits for the hosted `qwen` |
| `tests/` | The plumbing against fakes |

## Your agent goes in `solve()`

`solve(task, page)` gets the run and a Playwright page in browser 1:

- `task["brief"]`: the task and its rules;
- `task["access"]`: each website's `siteId`, `url` and `credentials`;
- `task["submission"]`: where the answer goes, `{"kind": "api", "url": ...}` or `{"kind": "site", "url": ...}`;
- `task["answer_schema"]`: the JSON Schema of the answer.

For an `api` submission, return the answer and `main()` submits it: `202` is accepted and final, `400` lists the
issues to fix. For a `site` submission, enter the answer on that website yourself and return `None`. Reading pages,
acting on them and working out the answer are yours to build.

Mind the clock: a scored run has 20 minutes, and `run.seconds_left(task)` says how many seconds are left. Every part
of the answer scores on its own, so submit your best answer about a minute before the end rather than keep
searching; an answer that comes too late scores 0.

More browsers: set `"browsers": 2` (up to 4) in `agent.json`, then `await browsers.connect(playwright, 1)` attaches
to browser 2.

## The hosted models in short

Both are free and need no key of yours: runs get the variables, and locally `atira scout --env` sets them, pointed
at `atira models proxy`.

```python
import models

text = await models.ask_qwen("Which button submits this form? ...")          # QWEN_BASE_URL, QWEN_API_KEY
yes = await models.ask_clef({"page": page_text}, "Is this the current revision?")  # CLEF_BASE_URL, CLEF_API_KEY
```

`models.qwen()` is an OpenAI SDK client, for tool calls, images and everything else. Clef is set only where the
platform hosts it; if your agent relies on it, list `"models": ["qwen", "clef"]` in `agent.json` so the run waits for
it to warm up. Another provider works with your own key through the run's metering proxy:
`$API/docs/run-contract.md#llm-calls`.

## Run it locally

You need [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/) (open a new terminal after installing it, so
it is on your PATH) and the Atira CLI, signed in once with `atira login`.

Terminal 1: start the free models and leave it open.

```sh
atira models proxy
```

Terminal 2, in this folder:

```sh
uv sync && uv run playwright install chromium
eval "$(atira scout --env)"     # the scouting logins, and the model variables pointed at that proxy
uv run --no-sync python agent.py
```

In PowerShell on Windows, Terminal 2:

```powershell
uv sync; uv run playwright install chromium
atira scout --env | Out-String | Invoke-Expression    # the same exports
uv run --no-sync python agent.py
```

A Chromium window opens (`HEADLESS=1` hides it). Nothing done with the scouting logins counts, and locally an answer
is printed, never submitted. If `atira` says `Unknown command: models`, run `atira upgrade`.

## Test-run it, then submit it

```sh
atira test-run .   # the sandbox, exactly like a scored run, on the public dataset; opens the run page live
atira submit .     # reviewed, then run once and scored for the leaderboard
```

Both pack this directory without what `.gitignore` excludes.

## Environment

| Variable | Set by | Used for |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `CHALLENGE_API_URL`, `CHALLENGE_RUN_TOKEN` | runs | the run, at `/v1/runs/current` |
| `CHALLENGE_SCOUTING` | `atira scout --env` | locally: the brief and the scouting logins |
| `CDP_URL`, `CDP_URLS` | runs | the sandbox's browsers; locally the kit starts its own Chromium |
| `QWEN_BASE_URL`, `QWEN_API_KEY` | runs, `atira scout --env` | the hosted Qwen |
| `CLEF_BASE_URL`, `CLEF_API_KEY` | runs, `atira scout --env`, when Clef is hosted | the hosted Clef |

## Docs

- How a run works: `$API/docs/run-contract.md`
- Building an agent: `$API/docs/building-an-agent.md`
- Fair play, the rules: `$API/docs/fair-play.md`

## Tests

```sh
uv run python -m unittest discover -s tests
```
